```{r}
  )

soc_nomination_name_audit <- soc_mapping_final %>%
  left_join(soc_nomination_counts_by_col, by = "colname") %>%
  mutate(
    n_nominations = ifelse(is.na(n_nominations), 0, n_nominations),
    nominated_by_anyone = ifelse(is.na(nominated_by_anyone), FALSE, nominated_by_anyone),

    nominee_name_audit = case_when(
      !is.na(nominee_name_title_final) & nominee_name_title_final != "" ~ nominee_name_title_final,
      !is.na(nominee_name_title) & nominee_name_title != "" ~ nominee_name_title,
      !is.na(extracted_name_final) & extracted_name_final != "" ~ extracted_name_final,
      !is.na(extracted_name) & extracted_name != "" ~ extracted_name,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    linked_to_gutsID = !is.na(gutsID_final) & str_squish(gutsID_final) != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(nominee_name_audit) %>%
  summarise(
    n_columns = n(),
    q_groups = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(q_group))), collapse = " | "),

    linked_to_gutsID = any(linked_to_gutsID),
    gutsID = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(gutsID_final[gutsID_final != ""]))), collapse = " | "),

    nominated_by_anyone = any(nominated_by_anyone, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nominations = sum(n_nominations, na.rm = TRUE),

    mapping_statuses = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(mapping_status_final))), collapse = " | "),
    any_keep_final = any(keep_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gutsID = ifelse(gutsID == "", NA_character_, gutsID)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(nominated_by_anyone),
    desc(linked_to_gutsID),
    nominee_name_audit
  )

write_audit_csv(soc_nomination_name_audit, full_nomination_audit_csv)

message("Full nomination-name audit written: ", full_nomination_audit_csv)
message("Unique nominee names: ", nrow(soc_nomination_name_audit))
message("Linked nominee names: ", sum(soc_nomination_name_audit$linked_to_gutsID, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Unlinked nominee names: ", sum(!soc_nomination_name_audit$linked_to_gutsID, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Nominee names nominated by anyone: ", sum(soc_nomination_name_audit$nominated_by_anyone, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Nominee names never nominated: ", sum(!soc_nomination_name_audit$nominated_by_anyone, na.rm = TRUE))

# -------------------------
# APPLY (PATCHED): sanitize ALL sociometric columns, anonymize when mapped/kept
#   Always for every sociometric column:
#     - remove value labels
#     - overwrite variable label (never leave original label)
#   If keep_final TRUE and gutsID_final present:
#     - var_label = gutsID_final
#   Else:
#     - var_label = safe placeholder (or blank) WITHOUT any names
#   Default: do NOT drop columns (prevents data purge)
# -------------------------
soc_lookup <- soc_mapping_final %>%
  mutate(
    colname = as.character(colname),
    gutsID_final = as.character(gutsID_final),
    keep_final = as.logical(keep_final)
  ) %>%
  select(colname, keep_final, gutsID_final, q_group)

soc_lookup_key <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(soc_lookup)), soc_lookup$colname)

part2_sociometric_cleaned <- part2_final

n_total_soc <- length(soc_cols)
n_anonymized_to_id <- 0L
n_sanitized_unmapped <- 0L
cols_to_drop <- character(0)

for (cn in soc_cols) {

  col <- part2_sociometric_cleaned[[cn]]

  # Always remove value labels (names can hide here)
  col <- labelled::remove_labels(col)

  idx <- soc_lookup_key[[cn]]
  if (!is.null(idx)) {
    keep <- isTRUE(soc_lookup$keep_final[idx])
    gid  <- str_squish(soc_lookup$gutsID_final[idx] %||% "")
    qg   <- soc_lookup$q_group[idx] %||% str_extract(cn, "sociometric_q\\d+")
  } else {
    keep <- FALSE
    gid  <- ""
    qg   <- str_extract(cn, "sociometric_q\\d+")
  }

  if (keep && !is.na(gid) && gid != "") {
    labelled::var_label(col) <- gid
    n_anonymized_to_id <- n_anonymized_to_id + 1L
  } else {
    labelled::var_label(col) <- safe_placeholder_label(cn, qg, blank = use_blank_placeholder)
    n_sanitized_unmapped <- n_sanitized_unmapped + 1L
    if (drop_unmapped_sociometrics) cols_to_drop <- c(cols_to_drop, cn)
  }

  part2_sociometric_cleaned[[cn]] <- col
}

if (drop_unmapped_sociometrics && length(cols_to_drop) > 0) {
  part2_sociometric_cleaned <- part2_sociometric_cleaned %>% select(-all_of(cols_to_drop))
}

stopifnot(nrow(part2_sociometric_cleaned) == nrow(part2_final))
part2_final <- part2_sociometric_cleaned

message("Sociometrics processed (PATCHED safe apply).")
message("  Sociometric cols detected: ", n_total_soc)
message("  Var label set to gutsID (kept): ", n_anonymized_to_id)
message("  Sanitized but unmapped (kept): ", n_sanitized_unmapped)
message("  Dropped (only if drop_unmapped_sociometrics=TRUE): ", ifelse(drop_unmapped_sociometrics, length(cols_to_drop), 0L))

# -------------------------
# QC checks
# -------------------------

# QC1: no value labels remain on ANY sociometric column still present
soc_cols_post <- grep(soc_prefix, names(part2_final), value = TRUE)
for (rx in exclude_regex) soc_cols_post <- soc_cols_post[!grepl(rx, soc_cols_post)]

has_any_val_labels <- any(vapply(soc_cols_post, function(cn) {
  !is.null(labelled::val_labels(part2_final[[cn]]))
}, logical(1)))
has_any_val_labels
# Expect: FALSE

# QC2: spot suspiciously long labels on sociometric cols (should be gutsID or UNMAPPED|...)
var_labels <- vapply(soc_cols_post, function(cn) {
  lb <- labelled::var_label(part2_final[[cn]])
  if (is.null(lb) || is.na(lb)) "" else as.character(lb)
}, character(1))

suspect <- tibble(
  colname = soc_cols_post,
  var_label = var_labels,
  nchar = nchar(var_labels)
) %>%
  filter(
    nchar > 60 |
      str_detect(str_to_lower(var_label), "\\b(van|de|der|wie|hoe|wat)\\b") |
      str_detect(var_label, "\\s")   # IDs/placeholders should have no spaces
  )

suspect
# Expect: 0 rows (or very small, investigate)

# QC3: quick manual sample
set.seed(1)
sample(soc_cols_post, size = min(5, length(soc_cols_post))) |>
  lapply(function(cn) {
    list(
      colname = cn,
      var_label = labelled::var_label(part2_final[[cn]]),
      val_labels = labelled::val_labels(part2_final[[cn]])
    )
  })

library(dplyr)

# duplicated gutsIDs in Part 2
dup_ids <- part2_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
  count(gutsID, name = "n_gutsID") %>%
  filter(n_gutsID > 1) %>%
  pull(gutsID)

# look up their ppns in Part 2 and join back to the identity ledger

bind_rows(

  tibble(dataset = "part2", n_missing_gutsID = sum(is.na(part2_final$gutsID) | trimws(part2_final$gutsID) == "")),

```


At this stage the pipeline transitions from identity resolution and participant level cleaning to the organization of survey measures themselves.

Up to this point the workflow has focused on stabilizing participant identifiers, linking participants to their GUTS subject IDs, and cleaning sociometric nomination fields so that all references to other participants are represented using anonymized IDs. With those structural issues resolved, the remaining steps focus on preparing the behavioral survey content for export.

Rather than defining measures directly within the script, the structure of the Wave 1 behavioral data is described in an external measure overview workbook. This file serves as the authoritative manifest describing how items belong to measures, how measures are grouped into components, and how they should ultimately be exported.

The next chunk reads this overview workbook and converts it into internal registry objects that will guide the remainder of the export process. These registries provide a stable description of the measure structure, ensuring that downstream measure splitting, reverse coding, and export steps all follow a consistent specification defined outside the code.





```{r}
###############################################################################
# CHUNK 1) MEASURE OVERVIEW MANIFEST (T1) -> LOCKED REGISTRIES
#
# Purpose
#   Read the T1 behavioral overview file (ordered to match Qualtrics), clean it,
#   validate only the minimum requirements needed for downstream steps, and then
#   produce TWO canonical registries:
#
#     1) registry_items    (item-level; one row per overview row)
#     2) registry_measures (measure-level; one row per short_name x component)
#
# Philosophy
#   Treat the overview as the authoritative source of truth. We therefore avoid
#   enforcing "descriptor consistency" checks that can legitimately vary by item
#   (e.g., references, subscales).
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
})

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP X.1) IMPORT OVERVIEW (T1)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

overview_path <- file.path(dir0, "Behavioral/T1/T1_behavioral_overview.xlsx")

if (!file.exists(overview_path)) {
  stop("T1_behavioral_overview.xlsx not found in data_dir.")
}

overview_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  path = overview_path,
  sheet = 1,
  .name_repair = "minimal"
)

overview <- overview_raw %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = where(is.character),
      .fns  = ~ stringr::str_squish(.x)
    )
  )

message("Overview rows: ", nrow(overview))
message("Overview columns: ", ncol(overview))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP X.2) CLEAN OVERVIEW (LOCKED)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Drop obvious Excel artifacts if present
overview <- overview %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("b", "x")))

# Fill down implied continuity for key columns (spreadsheet "same as above")
fill_cols <- c(
  "short_name",
  "component",
  "questionnaire",
  "subscales",
  "original_english_or_dutch",
  "back_translation_if_necessary_by",
  "references",
  "amount_of_items_in_original_questionnaire",
  "amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire"
)

overview <- overview %>%
  tidyr::fill(dplyr::any_of(fill_cols), .direction = "down")

# String hygiene for key columns
overview <- overview %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = dplyr::any_of(c("short_name", "component", "variable_name")),
      .fns  = ~ stringr::str_squish(.x)
    ),
    component = dplyr::if_else(is.na(component), NA_character_, tolower(component))
  )

# Coerce flags / counts into stable types
overview <- overview %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    reversed_items = suppressWarnings(as.integer(reversed_items)),
    amount_of_items_in_original_questionnaire =
      suppressWarnings(as.integer(amount_of_items_in_original_questionnaire)),
    amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire =
      suppressWarnings(as.integer(amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire))
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP X.3) MINIMUM VALIDATIONS (FAIL FAST ONLY WHEN NECESSARY)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Required columns must exist
required_cols <- c("short_name", "component", "variable_name")
missing_required <- setdiff(required_cols, names(overview))
if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
  stop("Overview is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_required, collapse = ", "))
}

# Required cells must be populated
bad_short <- which(is.na(overview$short_name) | overview$short_name == "")
bad_comp  <- which(is.na(overview$component)  | overview$component  == "")
bad_var   <- which(is.na(overview$variable_name) | overview$variable_name == "")

if (length(bad_short) > 0) stop("Overview has missing short_name in row(s): ", paste(head(bad_short, 20), collapse = ", "))
if (length(bad_comp)  > 0) stop("Overview has missing component in row(s): ", paste(head(bad_comp, 20), collapse = ", "))
if (length(bad_var)   > 0) stop("Overview has missing variable_name in row(s): ", paste(head(bad_var, 20), collapse = ", "))

# Component values must be expected
valid_components <- c("sensitive", "part1", "part2")
unexpected_components <- overview %>%
  dplyr::distinct(component) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!component %in% valid_components)

if (nrow(unexpected_components) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Overview has unexpected component value(s): ",
    paste(unexpected_components$component, collapse = ", "),
    "\nExpected: ", paste(valid_components, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Duplicate variable_name within a measure will break splitting later
dups_within_measure <- overview %>%
  dplyr::count(short_name, component, variable_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(dups_within_measure) > 0) {
  print(dups_within_measure, n = 200)
  stop("Duplicate variable_name(s) detected within short_name x component. See printed table.")
}

# Keep your old summary output
overview_summary <- overview %>%
  dplyr::count(short_name, component, name = "n_items") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(short_name, component)

print(overview_summary)
message("Manifest locked: ", nrow(overview), " rows across ", dplyr::n_distinct(overview$short_name), " measures.")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP X.4) BUILD REGISTRIES
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Ensure optional overview columns exist so downstream code can stay generic
if (!"variable_values" %in% names(overview)) {
  overview$variable_values <- NA_character_
}
if (!"variable_values_label" %in% names(overview)) {
  overview$variable_values_label <- NA_character_
}
if (!"variable_label" %in% names(overview)) {
  overview$variable_label <- NA_character_
}
if (!"reversed_items" %in% names(overview)) {
  overview$reversed_items <- NA_integer_
}

parse_numeric_range <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  if (is.na(x0) || x0 == "") {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, min = NA_real_, max = NA_real_))
  }

  m <- str_match(x0, "^(\\d+)\\s*to\\s*(\\d+)$")
  if (all(is.na(m))) {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, min = NA_real_, max = NA_real_))
  }

  list(
    ok  = TRUE,
    min = as.numeric(m[2]),
    max = as.numeric(m[3])
  )
}

parse_value_labels <- function(x) {
  x0 <- as.character(x)
  if (is.na(x0) || str_squish(x0) == "") {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, levels = NULL, n_levels = 0L))
  }

  parts <- str_split(x0, pattern = "[;\n\r]+", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  parts <- str_squish(parts)
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]

  m <- str_match(parts, "^\\s*(\\d+)\\s*[:=]\\s*(.+?)\\s*$")
  if (nrow(m) == 0 || all(is.na(m[, 2]))) {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, levels = NULL, n_levels = 0L))
  }

  ok_idx <- which(!is.na(m[, 2]) & !is.na(m[, 3]))
  if (length(ok_idx) == 0) {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, levels = NULL, n_levels = 0L))
  }

  keys <- m[ok_idx, 2]
  vals <- m[ok_idx, 3]

  keep <- !duplicated(keys)
  keys <- keys[keep]
  vals <- vals[keep]

  lv <- vals
  names(lv) <- keys

  list(
    ok       = TRUE,
    levels    = lv,
    n_levels  = length(lv)
  )
}

parse_all_numeric_codes <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  if (is.na(x0) || x0 == "") return(integer(0))

  ranges <- str_match_all(x0, "(\\d+)\\s*to\\s*(\\d+)")[[1]]

  range_codes <- integer(0)
  if (!is.null(ranges) && nrow(ranges) > 0) {
    range_codes <- purrr::map2(
      as.integer(ranges[, 2]),
      as.integer(ranges[, 3]),
      ~ seq(.x, .y)
    ) %>%
      unlist(use.names = FALSE)
  }

  x_no_ranges <- str_replace_all(x0, "(\\d+)\\s*to\\s*(\\d+)", " ")
  singleton_codes <- str_extract_all(x_no_ranges, "\\b\\d+\\b")[[1]]
  singleton_codes <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(singleton_codes))
  singleton_codes <- singleton_codes[!is.na(singleton_codes)]

  sort(unique(c(range_codes, singleton_codes)))
}

is_non_substantive_label <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  if (is.na(x0) || x0 == "") return(FALSE)

  str_detect(
    x0,
    paste(
      c(
        "niet van toepassing",
        "^nvt$",
        "^n\\.v\\.t\\.?$",
        "not applicable",
        "^n/?a$",
        "geen antwoord",
        "no answer",
        "no response",
        "geen respons",
        "weet ik niet",
        "ik weet het niet",
        "don't know",
        "do not know",
        "unknown",
        "onbekend",
        "geef ik liever geen antwoord op",
        "wil ik liever niet zeggen",
        "prefer not to answer",
        "rather not say",
        "refused",
        "missing"
      ),
      collapse = "|"
    )
  )
}

is_other_specify_label <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  if (is.na(x0) || x0 == "") return(FALSE)

  str_detect(
    x0,
    paste(
      c(
        "anders",
        "namelijk",
        "other",
        "specify"
      ),
      collapse = "|"
    )
  )
}

collapse_int_vec <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  x <- sort(unique(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(x, collapse = ";")
}

collapse_named_codes <- function(vals, codes) {
  if (is.null(vals) || length(vals) == 0 || length(codes) == 0) return(NA_character_)

  codes_chr <- as.character(codes)
  out <- purrr::map_chr(codes_chr, function(k) {
    lab <- vals[[k]]
    if (is.null(lab) || is.na(lab) || str_squish(lab) == "") {
      paste0(k, "=<unlabelled>")
    } else {
      paste0(k, "=", str_squish(as.character(lab)))
    }
  })

  if (length(out) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(out, collapse = "; ")
}

first_non_empty <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0) & x0 != ""]
  if (length(x0) == 0) NA_character_ else x0[1]
}

first_non_na_int <- function(x) {
  x0 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
  x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0)]
  if (length(x0) == 0) NA_integer_ else x0[1]
}

unique_non_empty <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0) & x0 != ""]
  unique(x0)
}

flatten_unique_chr <- function(x) {
  x0 <- unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
  x0 <- str_squish(as.character(x0))
  x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0) & x0 != ""]
  unique(x0)
}

summarise_code_scheme <- function(variable_values, variable_values_label) {
  range_info  <- parse_numeric_range(variable_values)
  levels_info <- parse_value_labels(variable_values_label)

  codes_from_values <- parse_all_numeric_codes(variable_values)

  codes_from_labels <- if (isTRUE(levels_info$ok)) {
    suppressWarnings(as.integer(names(levels_info$levels)))
  } else {
    integer(0)
  }
  codes_from_labels <- codes_from_labels[!is.na(codes_from_labels)]

  all_codes <- sort(unique(c(codes_from_values, codes_from_labels)))

  level_map <- if (isTRUE(levels_info$ok)) levels_info$levels else NULL

  special_codes_from_labels <- if (!is.null(level_map) && length(level_map) > 0) {
    labs <- as.character(level_map)
    keys <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(names(level_map)))
    keys[!is.na(keys) & purrr::map_lgl(labs, is_non_substantive_label)]
  } else {
    integer(0)
  }

  other_specify_codes <- if (!is.null(level_map) && length(level_map) > 0) {
    labs <- as.character(level_map)
    keys <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(names(level_map)))
    keys[!is.na(keys) & purrr::map_lgl(labs, is_other_specify_label)]
  } else {
    integer(0)
  }

  unlabeled_extra_codes <- integer(0)
  if (isTRUE(range_info$ok) && length(codes_from_values) > 0) {
    base_codes <- seq(as.integer(range_info$min), as.integer(range_info$max))
    unlabeled_extra_codes <- setdiff(codes_from_values, base_codes)
  }

  special_codes <- sort(unique(c(special_codes_from_labels, unlabeled_extra_codes)))
  substantive_codes <- sort(setdiff(all_codes, special_codes))

  if (length(substantive_codes) == 0 && isTRUE(range_info$ok)) {
    substantive_codes <- seq(as.integer(range_info$min), as.integer(range_info$max))
  }

  substantive_scale_min <- if (length(substantive_codes) > 0) min(substantive_codes) else NA_integer_
  substantive_scale_max <- if (length(substantive_codes) > 0) max(substantive_codes) else NA_integer_

  substantive_contiguous <- if (length(substantive_codes) > 0) {
    identical(substantive_codes, seq(min(substantive_codes), max(substantive_codes)))
  } else {
    FALSE
  }

  likely_scale_item <- isTRUE(range_info$ok) ||
    (length(substantive_codes) >= 4L && isTRUE(substantive_contiguous))

  special_code_above_scale <- if (length(special_codes) > 0 && !is.na(substantive_scale_max)) {
    any(special_codes > substantive_scale_max)
  } else {
    FALSE
  }

  special_code_below_scale <- if (length(special_codes) > 0 && !is.na(substantive_scale_min)) {
    any(special_codes < substantive_scale_min)
  } else {
    FALSE
  }

  needs_scale_recode <- isTRUE(likely_scale_item) &&
    length(special_codes) > 0 &&
    (isTRUE(special_code_above_scale) || isTRUE(special_code_below_scale))

  list(
    all_codes                  = all_codes,
    n_all_codes                = length(all_codes),

    special_codes              = special_codes,
    n_special_codes            = length(special_codes),
    has_special_codes          = length(special_codes) > 0,

    special_code_labels        = collapse_named_codes(level_map, special_codes),
    special_code_values        = collapse_int_vec(special_codes),

    other_specify_codes        = sort(unique(other_specify_codes)),
    other_specify_code_values  = collapse_int_vec(other_specify_codes),

    unlabeled_extra_codes      = sort(unique(unlabeled_extra_codes)),
    unlabeled_extra_code_values = collapse_int_vec(unlabeled_extra_codes),
    has_unlabeled_extra_codes  = length(unlabeled_extra_codes) > 0,

    substantive_codes          = substantive_codes,
    substantive_code_values    = collapse_int_vec(substantive_codes),
    substantive_n_codes        = length(substantive_codes),
    substantive_scale_min      = substantive_scale_min,
    substantive_scale_max      = substantive_scale_max,
    substantive_contiguous     = substantive_contiguous,

    likely_scale_item          = likely_scale_item,
    special_code_above_scale   = special_code_above_scale,
    special_code_below_scale   = special_code_below_scale,
    needs_scale_recode         = needs_scale_recode
  )
}

# ITEM-LEVEL registry
registry_items <- overview %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    overview_row = dplyr::row_number(),

    short_name    = str_squish(as.character(short_name)),
    component     = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
    variable_name = str_squish(as.character(variable_name)),

    reversed_flag = suppressWarnings(as.integer(reversed_items)),
    reversed_flag = dplyr::if_else(is.na(reversed_flag), 0L, reversed_flag),

    is_prefix          = str_ends(variable_name, "_"),
    variable_name_base = str_remove(variable_name, "_$"),

    range_parsed = purrr::map(variable_values, parse_numeric_range),
    scale_min    = purrr::map_dbl(range_parsed, ~ .x$min),
    scale_max    = purrr::map_dbl(range_parsed, ~ .x$max),
    range_ok     = purrr::map_lgl(range_parsed, ~ .x$ok),

    levels_parsed = purrr::map(variable_values_label, parse_value_labels),
    levels_ok     = purrr::map_lgl(levels_parsed, ~ .x$ok),
    n_levels      = purrr::map_int(levels_parsed, ~ .x$n_levels),

    code_meta = purrr::map2(variable_values, variable_values_label, summarise_code_scheme),

    all_code_values            = purrr::map_chr(code_meta, ~ collapse_int_vec(.x$all_codes)),
    n_all_codes                = purrr::map_int(code_meta, ~ .x$n_all_codes),

    has_special_codes          = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$has_special_codes),
    n_special_codes            = purrr::map_int(code_meta, ~ .x$n_special_codes),
    special_code_values        = purrr::map_chr(code_meta, ~ .x$special_code_values),
    special_code_labels        = purrr::map_chr(code_meta, ~ .x$special_code_labels),

    other_specify_code_values  = purrr::map_chr(code_meta, ~ .x$other_specify_code_values),

    has_unlabeled_extra_codes  = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$has_unlabeled_extra_codes),
    unlabeled_extra_code_values = purrr::map_chr(code_meta, ~ .x$unlabeled_extra_code_values),

    substantive_code_values    = purrr::map_chr(code_meta, ~ .x$substantive_code_values),
    substantive_n_codes        = purrr::map_int(code_meta, ~ .x$substantive_n_codes),
    substantive_scale_min      = purrr::map_dbl(code_meta, ~ as.numeric(.x$substantive_scale_min)),
    substantive_scale_max      = purrr::map_dbl(code_meta, ~ as.numeric(.x$substantive_scale_max)),
    substantive_contiguous     = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$substantive_contiguous),

    likely_scale_item          = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$likely_scale_item),
    special_code_above_scale   = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$special_code_above_scale),
    special_code_below_scale   = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$special_code_below_scale),
    needs_scale_recode         = purrr::map_lgl(code_meta, ~ .x$needs_scale_recode),

    scale_type = dplyr::case_when(
      likely_scale_item ~ "scale_like",
      levels_ok         ~ "categorical_levels",
      range_ok          ~ "numeric_range",
      TRUE              ~ "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(overview_row)

# MEASURE-LEVEL registry
registry_measures <- registry_items %>%
  dplyr::group_by(component, short_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    overview_row_start = min(overview_row),
    overview_row_end   = max(overview_row),

    n_items_manifest   = dplyr::n(),
    variable_names_manifest = list(variable_name),

    questionnaire = if ("questionnaire" %in% names(registry_items)) first_non_empty(questionnaire) else NA_character_,
    references    = if ("references" %in% names(registry_items)) first_non_empty(references) else NA_character_,

    original_english_or_dutch =
      if ("original_english_or_dutch" %in% names(registry_items)) first_non_empty(original_english_or_dutch) else NA_character_,
    back_translation_if_necessary_by =
      if ("back_translation_if_necessary_by" %in% names(registry_items)) first_non_empty(back_translation_if_necessary_by) else NA_character_,

    amount_of_items_in_original_questionnaire =
      if ("amount_of_items_in_original_questionnaire" %in% names(registry_items)) first_non_na_int(amount_of_items_in_original_questionnaire) else NA_integer_,
    amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire =
      if ("amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire" %in% names(registry_items)) first_non_na_int(amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire) else NA_integer_,

    subscales_all = list(
      if ("subscales" %in% names(registry_items)) unique_non_empty(subscales) else character(0)
    ),
    n_subscales = if ("subscales" %in% names(registry_items)) length(unique_non_empty(subscales)) else 0L,
    has_multiple_subscales = n_subscales > 1L,

    has_prefix_items   = any(is_prefix, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_reversed_items = any(reversed_flag == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_numeric_ranges = any(range_ok, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_levels_info    = any(levels_ok, na.rm = TRUE),

    has_special_codes      = any(has_special_codes, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_special_code_items   = sum(has_special_codes, na.rm = TRUE),
    special_code_vars      = list(variable_name[has_special_codes]),
    special_code_values_all = list(flatten_unique_chr(str_split(special_code_values[has_special_codes], ";", simplify = FALSE))),

    has_scale_recode_items = any(needs_scale_recode, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_scale_recode_items   = sum(needs_scale_recode, na.rm = TRUE),
    scale_recode_vars      = list(variable_name[needs_scale_recode]),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(component, short_name)

# Informational warning only: item-count mismatches
count_mismatch <- registry_measures %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(count_diff = n_items_manifest - amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire) %>%
  dplyr::filter(count_diff != 0)

if (nrow(count_mismatch) > 0) {
  message("NOTE: Item-count mismatches detected (manifest vs amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire).")
  print(
    count_mismatch %>%
      dplyr::select(component, short_name, n_items_manifest, amount_of_items_in_guts_questionnaire, count_diff),
    n = 200
  )
}

scale_recode_watch <- registry_items %>%
  dplyr::filter(needs_scale_recode) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    component,
    short_name,
    variable_name,
    variable_values,
    variable_values_label,
    scale_min,
    scale_max,
    substantive_scale_min,
    substantive_scale_max,
    special_code_values,
    special_code_labels
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(component, short_name, variable_name)

if (nrow(scale_recode_watch) > 0) {
  message("Registry review: scale-like items with special codes outside the substantive range detected.")
  print(scale_recode_watch, n = 200)
}

special_code_summary <- registry_measures %>%
  dplyr::filter(has_special_codes | has_scale_recode_items) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    component,
    short_name,
    n_items_manifest,
    n_special_code_items,
    n_scale_recode_items
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(component, short_name)

if (nrow(special_code_summary) > 0) {
  message("Registry review: measures containing special-coded items.")
  print(special_code_summary, n = 200)
}

message("Registry items:    ", nrow(registry_items), " rows.")
message("Registry measures: ", nrow(registry_measures), " component x short_name blocks.")

registry_measures_summary <- registry_measures %>%
  dplyr::count(component, name = "n_measures") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(component)

print(registry_measures_summary)

# Objects available downstream:
#   - overview
#   - registry_items
#   - registry_measures

```



With the measure structure now defined through the overview registries, the next step focuses on preparing the sociometric nomination data for network analysis.

The sociometric questions in the Wave 1 survey capture directed relationships between participants, such as friendship nominations. While these responses originate as standard survey variables, they represent relational data and therefore require a different export format than the other behavioral measures.

To support network analyses, these nominations are converted into edgelists, where each row represents a directed tie from one participant to another. In this structure the nominating participant becomes the source node and the nominated participant becomes the target node. Because earlier steps in the pipeline replaced raw names with anonymized gutsID values, the resulting edgelists can safely represent the social network while maintaining participant privacy.

The following chunk constructs these edgelists for each sociometric question and prepares them for export so that they can be used directly in downstream social network analyses.




```{r}
###############################################################################
# STEP X) SOCIOMETRICS -> EDGELISTS + SUBJECT-LEVEL NOMINATION ROSTERS (PART2)
#
# Purpose
#   Convert sociometric nomination blocks in Part 2 into:
#     1) clean edgelists for network analysis
#     2) subject-level padded nomination files using the full linkage-based roster
#
#   Produces ONE output pair per sociometric question base (e.g., sociometric_q21):
#
#     Edgelist
#       from     = ego gutsID (row-level)
#       to       = alter gutsID (stored in VARIABLE LABEL of each nomination column)
#       question = sociometric base code (sociometric_q21)
#       item     = human readable item text from overview variable_label
#
#     Nomination roster
#       gutsID       = full linkage-based subject roster
#       nominations  = semicolon-separated nominated gutsIDs
#                      OR "no_participation" if subject was not in part2_final
#                      OR blank if present in part2_final but no nominations recorded
#
# Key assumptions
#   - Nomination cells are binary: NA = not nominated / no recorded nomination, 1 = nominated
#   - "Open question" sociometric items are NOT nominations and must be excluded.
#   - Sociometric nomination bases are identified from the ACTUAL part2_final
#     column names (e.g., sociometric_q21_1, sociometric_q21_2, ...), not only
#     from registry variable_name rows. This avoids conflating exact open-question
#     variables such as sociometric_q21 with true nomination blocks sociometric_q21_*.
#
# Inputs assumed available
#   - part2_final     : cleaned Part 2 dataframe (post-sociometric anonymization)
#   - registry_items  : item-level manifest registry from Chunk 1
#   - linkage         : linkage file used to define the full subject roster
#
# Outputs (in memory)
#   - sociometric_edgelists           : named list; one edgelist per sociometric base
#   - sociometric_unmapped            : named list; dropped nominations where `to` is missing/unmapped
#   - sociometric_nomination_rosters  : named list; one padded two-column file per sociometric base
#   - sociometric_edgelist_all        : combined edgelist across all sociometric bases
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(labelled)
  library(readr)
})

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

guts_col <- {
  guts_candidates <- c("gutsID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "GUTSID", "GutsID")
  gc <- guts_candidates[guts_candidates %in% names(part2_final)][1]
  if (is.na(gc)) stop("Could not find a gutsID column in part2_final.")
  gc
}

get_linkage_guts_col <- function(df) {
  guts_candidates <- c("gutsID", "ID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "GUTSID", "GutsID")
  gc <- guts_candidates[guts_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  if (is.na(gc)) stop("Could not find a gutsID column in linkage.")
  gc
}

is_open_question <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  !is.na(x0) & x0 == "open question"
}

drop_unmapped_to <- TRUE
unmapped_prefix  <- "unmapped"  # case-insensitive startsWith check

first_non_empty <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0) & x0 != ""]
  if (length(x0) == 0) NA_character_ else x0[1]
}

assert_unique_guts <- function(df, dataset_label = "dataset") {
  stopifnot("gutsID" %in% names(df))

  dup_ids <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
    count(gutsID, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(dup_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate gutsID values detected in ",
      dataset_label,
      ": ",
      paste(head(dup_ids$gutsID, 10), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  invisible(df)
}

pick_preferred_item_label <- function(labels, value_specs) {
  non_open_idx <- which(!is_open_question(value_specs))
  lab_non_open <- first_non_empty(labels[non_open_idx])
  if (!is.na(lab_non_open)) return(lab_non_open)
  first_non_empty(labels)
}

extract_soc_nomination_bases_from_data <- function(nms) {
  # Only columns with a trailing underscore block count as nomination columns
  soc_nom_cols <- nms[str_detect(nms, "^sociometric_q_?\\d+_")]

  if (length(soc_nom_cols) == 0) return(character(0))

  bases <- str_match(soc_nom_cols, "^(sociometric_q_?\\d+)_")[, 2]
  bases <- bases[!is.na(bases)]

  sort(unique(bases))
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preconditions
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("registry_items")) {
  stop("registry_items not found. Run Chunk 1 registry prep before this step.")
}
if (!exists("linkage")) {
  stop("linkage not found. Sociometric roster export requires linkage.")
}

need_cols <- c("component", "variable_name", "variable_values", "variable_label")
missing_cols <- setdiff(need_cols, names(registry_items))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "registry_items is missing required column(s) for sociometrics: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAdd these columns to Chunk 1 registry prep so we can pull item text from the overview."
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full linkage-based roster + Part 2 respondent set
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

linkage_guts_col <- get_linkage_guts_col(linkage)

subject_roster_soc <- linkage %>%
  transmute(gutsID = as.character(.data[[linkage_guts_col]])) %>%
  mutate(gutsID = str_squish(gutsID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
  distinct(gutsID) %>%
  arrange(gutsID)

assert_unique_guts(subject_roster_soc, "subject_roster_soc")

expected_n_subjects <- nrow(subject_roster_soc)

if (expected_n_subjects == 0) {
  stop("subject_roster_soc is empty. Check linkage and gutsID column selection.")
}

part2_respondent_ids <- part2_final %>%
  transmute(gutsID = as.character(.data[[guts_col]])) %>%
  mutate(gutsID = str_squish(gutsID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
  distinct(gutsID) %>%
  arrange(gutsID) %>%
  pull(gutsID)

part2_respondents_not_in_roster <- setdiff(part2_respondent_ids, subject_roster_soc$gutsID)
if (length(part2_respondents_not_in_roster) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Some Part 2 respondents are not present in the linkage-based subject roster: ",
    paste(head(part2_respondents_not_in_roster, 20), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

message("Linkage-based sociometric subject roster: ", nrow(subject_roster_soc), " subjects")
message("Part 2 respondents detected within roster: ", length(part2_respondent_ids))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify sociometric nomination bases from ACTUAL data columns
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

soc_bases <- extract_soc_nomination_bases_from_data(names(part2_final))

if (length(soc_bases) == 0) {
  message("No sociometric nomination bases found in part2_final column names.")
  sociometric_edgelists          <- list()
  sociometric_unmapped           <- list()
  sociometric_nomination_rosters <- list()
  sociometric_edgelist_all       <- tibble(
    from     = character(),
    to       = character(),
    question = character(),
    item     = character()
  )

} else {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build lookup: sociometric_qXX -> overview variable_label (item text)
  # Prefer non-open-question registry rows when duplicates exist.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  soc_item_lookup <- registry_items %>%
    mutate(
      component       = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
      variable_name   = str_squish(as.character(variable_name)),
      variable_values = variable_values,
      variable_label  = variable_label
    ) %>%
    filter(component == "part2") %>%
    filter(variable_name %in% soc_bases) %>%
    group_by(variable_name) %>%
    summarise(
      item = pick_preferred_item_label(variable_label, variable_values),
      n_registry_rows = n(),
      n_non_open_rows = sum(!is_open_question(variable_values), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  soc_item_key <- setNames(soc_item_lookup$item, soc_item_lookup$variable_name)

  bases_missing_lookup <- setdiff(soc_bases, soc_item_lookup$variable_name)
  if (length(bases_missing_lookup) > 0) {
    message(
      "NOTE: Some sociometric bases were found in part2_final but not in registry_items: ",
      paste(bases_missing_lookup, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  message("Sociometric nomination bases found in data: ", length(soc_bases))
  if (nrow(soc_item_lookup) > 0) {
    message("Sociometric item label lookup summary:")
    print(
      soc_item_lookup %>%
        arrange(variable_name),
      n = Inf
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Build outputs for one base (e.g., sociometric_q21)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build_soc_outputs <- function(df, base) {

    col_prefix <- paste0(base, "_")
    soc_cols <- names(df)[str_starts(names(df), fixed(col_prefix))]

    item_text <- soc_item_key[[base]]
    if (is.null(item_text) || is.na(item_text) || item_text == "") item_text <- NA_character_

    if (length(soc_cols) == 0) {
      message("No columns found for base: ", base)

      roster_empty <- subject_roster_soc %>%
        mutate(
          nominations = ifelse(gutsID %in% part2_respondent_ids, NA_character_, "no_participation")
        )

      return(list(
        edges    = tibble(from = character(0), to = character(0), question = character(0), item = character(0)),
        unmapped = tibble(),
        roster   = roster_empty
      ))
    }

    # Long form over nomination columns
    long <- purrr::map_dfr(soc_cols, function(cn) {

      col <- df[[cn]]
      val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(col))

      to_id <- labelled::var_label(col)
      to_id <- str_squish(as.character(to_id))

      tibble(
        from_gutsID = as.character(df[[guts_col]]),
        to_gutsID   = ifelse(is.na(to_id) | to_id == "", NA_character_, to_id),
        value       = val,
        source_col  = cn
      )
    }) %>%
      mutate(
        from_gutsID = str_squish(from_gutsID),
        to_gutsID   = str_squish(to_gutsID)
      )

    # Keep only nominations (binary rule)
    long_keep <- long %>%
      filter(!is.na(from_gutsID), from_gutsID != "") %>%
      filter(value == 1)

    # Identify unmapped/missing to IDs
    is_unmapped <- is.na(long_keep$to_gutsID) | long_keep$to_gutsID == "" |
      str_starts(tolower(long_keep$to_gutsID), unmapped_prefix)

    unmapped <- long_keep %>% filter(is_unmapped)

    long_edges <- if (drop_unmapped_to) long_keep %>% filter(!is_unmapped) else long_keep

    # Clean edgelist output
    edges <- long_edges %>%
      transmute(
        from     = from_gutsID,
        to       = to_gutsID,
        question = base,
        item     = item_text
      ) %>%
      distinct()

    # Collapse nominations by subject for padded two-column export
    nominations_by_subject <- edges %>%
      group_by(from) %>%
      summarise(
        nominations = paste(sort(unique(to)), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      rename(gutsID = from)

    roster <- subject_roster_soc %>%
      left_join(nominations_by_subject, by = "gutsID") %>%
      mutate(
        nominations = case_when(
          !(gutsID %in% part2_respondent_ids) ~ "no_participation",
          TRUE ~ nominations
        )
      ) %>%
      arrange(gutsID)

    assert_unique_guts(roster, paste0(base, " nomination roster"))

    if (nrow(roster) != expected_n_subjects) {
      stop(
        "Nomination roster row count mismatch for ", base,
        ": got ", nrow(roster), ", expected ", expected_n_subjects
      )
    }

    list(edges = edges, unmapped = unmapped, roster = roster)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build all outputs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  built <- purrr::set_names(
    purrr::map(soc_bases, ~ build_soc_outputs(part2_final, .x)),
    soc_bases
  )

  sociometric_edgelists          <- purrr::map(built, "edges")
  sociometric_unmapped           <- purrr::map(built, "unmapped")
  sociometric_nomination_rosters <- purrr::map(built, "roster")

  sociometric_edgelist_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    sociometric_edgelists,
    function(df, q) {
      df2 <- df
      if (!"question" %in% names(df2)) df2$question <- q
      if (!"item" %in% names(df2)) df2$item <- NA_character_
      df2
    }
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Summary
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  soc_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(sociometric_edgelists, function(ed, nm) {
    tibble(
      question = nm,
      item     = dplyr::first(ed$item),
      n_edges  = nrow(ed),
      n_from   = dplyr::n_distinct(ed$from),
      n_to     = dplyr::n_distinct(ed$to)
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(question)

  message("Sociometric edgelist summary:")
  print(soc_summary, n = Inf)

  roster_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(sociometric_nomination_rosters, function(df, nm) {
    tibble(
      question           = nm,
      n_rows             = nrow(df),
      n_with_nominations = sum(!is.na(df$nominations) & df$nominations != "" & df$nominations != "no_participation"),
      n_no_participation = sum(df$nominations == "no_participation", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_blank_remaining  = sum(is.na(df$nominations) | df$nominations == "")
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(question)

  message("Sociometric nomination roster summary:")
  print(roster_summary, n = Inf)

  unmapped_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(sociometric_unmapped, function(ed, nm) {
    tibble(
      question = nm,
      n_unmapped_edges = nrow(ed),
      n_unmapped_cols  = dplyr::n_distinct(ed$source_col)
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(question)

  if (sum(unmapped_summary$n_unmapped_edges) > 0) {
    message("NOTE: Unmapped nominations were detected.")
    message("      drop_unmapped_to = ", drop_unmapped_to)
    print(unmapped_summary, n = Inf)
  }
}

# Outputs now available for export:
#   - sociometric_edgelists
#   - sociometric_unmapped
#   - sociometric_nomination_rosters
#   - sociometric_edgelist_all
```



Unlike the sociometric nomination items, most of the remaining variables reflect individual level questionnaire measures made up of multiple items that belong together as a scale or subscale. In the raw survey export these items are embedded within a much larger dataset, making them less convenient for downstream analysis and less transparent for future users of the cleaned files.

Using the measure registries created earlier, the script identifies the items belonging to each measure and extracts them into separate measure specific datasets. At this stage the workflow also applies any required reverse coding, ensuring that item orientations are aligned consistently within each exported measure according to the specifications defined in the overview manifest.

This step transforms the cleaned survey file into a structured collection of measure level outputs that preserve participant identifiers, retain item level responses, and incorporate the item direction adjustments needed for later scoring and analysis.


```{r}
###############################################################################
# CHUNK X) SPLIT MEASURES (FROM REGISTRY) + APPLY SCALE RECODE RULES +
#          PAD TO FULL LINKAGE-BASED SUBJECT ROSTER
#
# Purpose
#   Build component-specific measure dataframes using registry_items, apply
#   registry-driven special-code recoding for scale-like items, then pad each
#   measure dataset to the full linkage-based subject roster so all exported
#   files have the same number of rows.
#
# Inputs assumed available
#   - registry_items
#   - linkage
#   - part1_final
#   - sensitive_final
#   - part2_final
#
# Outputs
#   - subject_roster                     : full linkage-based subject roster
#   - expected_n_subjects                : expected row count for padded outputs
#   - <component>_measures_list_raw      : split datasets (observed participants only)
#   - <component>_measures_list_recoded  : split datasets after registry-driven
#                                          special-code recoding
#   - <component>_measures_list_final    : recoded datasets padded to full
#                                          linkage-based subject roster
#   - scale_recode_summary               : audit summary of recoded values
#
# Notes
#   - Sociometric nomination blocks (part2, sociometric_q*, NOT open question)
#     are excluded from part2 questionnaire measures because they are handled
#     separately in the sociometric branch.
#   - Raw split datasets remain unchanged and reflect observed participation only.
#   - Registry-driven scale recoding converts special numeric codes (e.g., 8,
#     888) to NA ONLY for items flagged in registry_items as
#     needs_scale_recode == TRUE.
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

stopifnot(exists("registry_items"))
stopifnot(exists("linkage"))
stopifnot(exists("part1_final"))
stopifnot(exists("sensitive_final"))
stopifnot(exists("part2_final"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_guts_col <- function(df) {
  guts_candidates <- c("gutsID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "GUTSID", "GutsID")
  guts_col <- guts_candidates[guts_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  if (is.na(guts_col)) stop("Could not find a gutsID column in dataset.")
  guts_col
}

get_linkage_guts_col <- function(df) {
  guts_candidates <- c("gutsID", "ID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "GUTSID", "GutsID")
  guts_col <- guts_candidates[guts_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  if (is.na(guts_col)) stop("Could not find a gutsID column in linkage.")
  guts_col
}

is_open_question <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  !is.na(x0) & x0 == "open question"
}

assert_unique_guts <- function(df, dataset_label = "dataset") {
  stopifnot("gutsID" %in% names(df))

  dup_ids <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
    count(gutsID, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(dup_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate gutsID values detected in ",
      dataset_label,
      ": ",
      paste(head(dup_ids$gutsID, 10), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  invisible(df)
}

pad_to_subject_roster <- function(df, subject_roster, dataset_label = "dataset") {
  stopifnot("gutsID" %in% names(df))
  stopifnot("gutsID" %in% names(subject_roster))

  assert_unique_guts(df, dataset_label = dataset_label)

  out <- subject_roster %>%
    left_join(df, by = "gutsID") %>%
    arrange(gutsID)

  assert_unique_guts(out, dataset_label = paste0(dataset_label, " (padded)"))

  out
}

parse_special_code_values <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  if (is.na(x0) || x0 == "") return(numeric(0))

  vals <- str_split(x0, ";", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  vals <- str_squish(vals)
  vals <- vals[vals != ""]
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]

  sort(unique(vals))
}

find_matching_columns <- function(df, var) {
  prefix <- if (str_ends(var, "_")) var else paste0(var, "_")
  base   <- str_remove(var, "_$")

  exact_candidates <- unique(c(var, base))
  exact_match  <- exact_candidates[exact_candidates %in% names(df)]
  prefix_match <- names(df)[str_starts(names(df), fixed(prefix))]

  unique(c(exact_match, prefix_match))
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full linkage-based subject roster
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

linkage_guts_col <- get_linkage_guts_col(linkage)

subject_roster <- linkage %>%
  transmute(gutsID = as.character(.data[[linkage_guts_col]])) %>%
  mutate(gutsID = str_squish(gutsID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
  distinct(gutsID) %>%
  arrange(gutsID)

assert_unique_guts(subject_roster, "subject_roster")

expected_n_subjects <- nrow(subject_roster)

if (expected_n_subjects == 0) {
  stop("subject_roster is empty. Check linkage and gutsID column selection.")
}

message("Full linkage-based questionnaire export roster built: ", expected_n_subjects, " unique subjects.")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize registry + flag sociometric nomination blocks for exclusion
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

registry_items2 <- registry_items %>%
  mutate(
    component             = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
    short_name            = str_squish(as.character(short_name)),
    variable_name         = str_squish(as.character(variable_name)),
    variable_values       = if ("variable_values" %in% names(.)) variable_values else NA_character_,
    variable_values_label = if ("variable_values_label" %in% names(.)) variable_values_label else NA_character_,
    needs_scale_recode    = if ("needs_scale_recode" %in% names(.)) as.logical(needs_scale_recode) else FALSE,
    special_code_values   = if ("special_code_values" %in% names(.)) special_code_values else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_sociometric_base       = component == "part2" & str_starts(variable_name, "sociometric_q"),
    is_sociometric_nomination = is_sociometric_base & !is_open_question(variable_values)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Splitter (registry-driven)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

split_component_measures_registry <- function(df, component_name, registry_items_df) {

  guts_col <- get_guts_col(df)

  reg <- registry_items_df %>%
    filter(component == component_name) %>%
    filter(!is.na(short_name), short_name != "") %>%
    filter(!is.na(variable_name), variable_name != "")

  # Exclude part2 sociometric nomination blocks from questionnaire measures
  if (component_name == "part2") {
    reg <- reg %>% filter(!isTRUE(is_sociometric_nomination))
  }

  if (nrow(reg) == 0) {
    message("No registry rows found for component: ", component_name)
    return(list())
  }

  measures <- reg %>%
    group_by(short_name) %>%
    summarise(vars = list(variable_name), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      data = purrr::map(vars, function(v) {

        selected_cols <- character(0)

        for (var in v) {
          matches <- find_matching_columns(df, var)

          if (length(matches) == 0) {
            stop("Variable not found in ", component_name, ": ", var)
          }

          selected_cols <- c(selected_cols, matches)
        }

        selected_cols <- unique(selected_cols)
        keep_cols <- c(guts_col, selected_cols)

        out <- df %>% select(all_of(keep_cols))

        if (guts_col != "gutsID") {
          out <- out %>% rename(gutsID = all_of(guts_col))
        }

        out
      })
    )

  out_list <- measures$data
  names(out_list) <- measures$short_name
  out_list
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Registry-driven special-code recoding
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

apply_scale_recode_rules <- function(measures_list_raw, component_name, registry_items_df) {

  reg_recode <- registry_items_df %>%
    filter(component == component_name) %>%
    filter(needs_scale_recode) %>%
    filter(!is.na(short_name), short_name != "") %>%
    filter(!is.na(variable_name), variable_name != "") %>%
    mutate(
      recode_values = purrr::map(special_code_values, parse_special_code_values)
    ) %>%
    filter(purrr::map_int(recode_values, length) > 0) %>%
    select(short_name, variable_name, recode_values)

  if (nrow(reg_recode) == 0) {
    message("Scale recoding (", component_name, "): no items flagged for recoding.")
    return(list(
      measures = measures_list_raw,
      summary  = tibble(
        component        = character(),
        short_name       = character(),
        variable_name    = character(),
        column_name      = character(),
        recode_values    = character(),
        n_values_recoded = integer()
      )
    ))
  }

  recode_summary <- tibble(
    component        = character(),
    short_name       = character(),
    variable_name    = character(),
    column_name      = character(),
    recode_values    = character(),
    n_values_recoded = integer()
  )

  measures_list_recoded <- purrr::imap(measures_list_raw, function(df, meas) {

    info <- reg_recode %>% filter(short_name == meas)
    if (nrow(info) == 0) return(df)

    df_out <- df

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(info))) {
      v     <- info$variable_name[i]
      codes <- info$recode_values[[i]]

      if (length(codes) == 0) next

      target_cols <- setdiff(find_matching_columns(df_out, v), "gutsID")
      if (length(target_cols) == 0) next

      for (col in target_cols) {
        x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_out[[col]]))
        if (all(is.na(x_num))) next

        hit_idx <- !is.na(x_num) & x_num %in% codes
        n_hit <- sum(hit_idx, na.rm = TRUE)

        if (n_hit > 0) {
          x_num[hit_idx] <- NA_real_
          df_out[[col]] <- x_num

          recode_summary <<- bind_rows(
            recode_summary,
            tibble(
              component        = component_name,
              short_name       = meas,
              variable_name    = v,
              column_name      = col,
              recode_values    = paste(codes, collapse = ";"),
              n_values_recoded = n_hit
            )
          )
        }
      }
    }

    df_out
  })

  if (nrow(recode_summary) == 0) {
    message("Scale recoding (", component_name, "): items were flagged, but no matching coded values were found in data.")
  } else {
    message("Scale recoding summary (", component_name, "):")
    print(
      recode_summary %>%
        group_by(short_name, variable_name, recode_values) %>%
        summarise(
          n_columns_touched = n(),
          n_values_recoded  = sum(n_values_recoded),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(n_values_recoded), short_name, variable_name),
      n = Inf
    )
  }

  list(
    measures = measures_list_recoded,
    summary  = recode_summary
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Split lists (RAW: observed participants only)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

part1_measures_list_raw     <- split_component_measures_registry(part1_final,     "part1",     registry_items2)
sensitive_measures_list_raw <- split_component_measures_registry(sensitive_final, "sensitive", registry_items2)
part2_measures_list_raw     <- split_component_measures_registry(part2_final,     "part2",     registry_items2)

print(tibble(component = "part1",     n_measures = length(part1_measures_list_raw)))
print(tibble(component = "sensitive", n_measures = length(sensitive_measures_list_raw)))
print(tibble(component = "part2",     n_measures = length(part2_measures_list_raw)))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply registry-driven scale recoding (observed participants only)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

part1_recode_result     <- apply_scale_recode_rules(part1_measures_list_raw,     "part1",     registry_items2)
sensitive_recode_result <- apply_scale_recode_rules(sensitive_measures_list_raw, "sensitive", registry_items2)
part2_recode_result     <- apply_scale_recode_rules(part2_measures_list_raw,     "part2",     registry_items2)

part1_measures_list_recoded     <- part1_recode_result$measures
sensitive_measures_list_recoded <- sensitive_recode_result$measures
part2_measures_list_recoded     <- part2_recode_result$measures

scale_recode_summary <- bind_rows(
  part1_recode_result$summary,
  sensitive_recode_result$summary,
  part2_recode_result$summary
)

if (nrow(scale_recode_summary) > 0) {
  message("Overall scale recode summary:")
  print(
    scale_recode_summary %>%
      count(component, short_name, name = "n_columns_recoded") %>%
      arrange(component, short_name),
    n = Inf
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pad recoded split lists to full linkage-based subject roster
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

part1_measures_list_final <- purrr::imap(
  part1_measures_list_recoded,
  ~ pad_to_subject_roster(.x, subject_roster, dataset_label = paste0("part1/", .y))
)

sensitive_measures_list_final <- purrr::imap(
  sensitive_measures_list_recoded,
  ~ pad_to_subject_roster(.x, subject_roster, dataset_label = paste0("sensitive/", .y))
)

part2_measures_list_final <- purrr::imap(
  part2_measures_list_recoded,
  ~ pad_to_subject_roster(.x, subject_roster, dataset_label = paste0("part2/", .y))
)

print(tibble(component = "part1",     expected_rows = expected_n_subjects))
print(tibble(component = "sensitive", expected_rows = expected_n_subjects))
print(tibble(component = "part2",     expected_rows = expected_n_subjects))

# Objects now available downstream:
#   - subject_roster
#   - expected_n_subjects
#   - part1_measures_list_raw
#   - sensitive_measures_list_raw
#   - part2_measures_list_raw
#   - part1_measures_list_recoded
#   - sensitive_measures_list_recoded
#   - part2_measures_list_recoded
#   - scale_recode_summary
#   - part1_measures_list_final
#   - sensitive_measures_list_final
#   - part2_measures_list_final
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
summarise_measure_df <- function(df, component, short_name, stage, subject_ids) {
  
  id_cols <- intersect(
    c("gutsID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "subject_id", "participant_id", "ppn", "PPN", "ResponseId", "response_id"),
    names(df)
  )
  
  item_cols <- setdiff(names(df), id_cols)
  
  if (length(item_cols) == 0) {
    row_has_data <- rep(FALSE, nrow(df))
  } else {
    item_present <- as.data.frame(
      lapply(df[item_cols], function(x) {
        !is.na(x) & str_squish(as.character(x)) != ""
      })
    )
    row_has_data <- rowSums(item_present, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }
  
  guts <- if ("gutsID" %in% names(df)) {
    str_squish(as.character(df$gutsID))
  } else {
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
  }
  
  tibble(
    component = component,
    short_name = short_name,
    stage = stage,
    n_rows = nrow(df),
    n_item_cols = length(item_cols),
    n_any_item_data = sum(row_has_data, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_all_item_missing = sum(!row_has_data, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_all_item_missing = round(100 * n_all_item_missing / n_rows, 2),
    n_with_data_missing_gutsID = sum(row_has_data & (is.na(guts) | guts == ""), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_with_data_id_not_in_roster = sum(row_has_data & !is.na(guts) & guts != "" & !(guts %in% subject_ids), na.rm = TRUE),
    example_data_ids_not_in_roster = paste(head(unique(guts[row_has_data & !is.na(guts) & guts != "" & !(guts %in% subject_ids)]), 10), collapse = "; ")
  )
}

summarise_measure_list <- function(measures_list, component, stage, subject_ids) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(
    measures_list,
    ~ summarise_measure_df(.x, component, .y, stage, subject_ids)
  )
}

measure_stage_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_measure_list(part1_measures_list_raw,         "part1",     "raw",     subject_ids),
  summarise_measure_list(sensitive_measures_list_raw,     "sensitive", "raw",     subject_ids),
  summarise_measure_list(part2_measures_list_raw,         "part2",     "raw",     subject_ids),
  
  summarise_measure_list(part1_measures_list_recoded,     "part1",     "recoded", subject_ids),
  summarise_measure_list(sensitive_measures_list_recoded, "sensitive", "recoded", subject_ids),
  summarise_measure_list(part2_measures_list_recoded,     "part2",     "recoded", subject_ids),

  summarise_measure_list(sensitive_measures_list_final,   "sensitive", "final",   subject_ids),
  summarise_measure_list(part2_measures_list_final,       "part2",     "final",   subject_ids)
) %>%
  arrange(component, short_name, factor(stage, levels = c("raw", "recoded", "final")))
```
