```{r}
###############################################################################
# CHUNK X) QC CHECKS AFTER REGISTRY / SOCIOMETRICS / SPLIT / RECODE / PADDING
#
# Purpose
#   Perform hard-stop structural checks plus review summaries for the updated
#   Wave 1 cleaning pipeline.
#
# Hard-stop checks
#   - Linkage-based roster integrity
#   - Registry integrity for recode-flagged items
#   - Measure-name consistency across stages
#   - Raw -> recoded consistency
#   - Recode behavior (only flagged items changed; flagged special codes removed)
#   - Final padded roster integrity
#   - Sociometric roster / edgelist integrity
#   - Export-readiness naming collisions
#
# Review outputs
#   - qc_registry_recode_watch
#   - qc_measure_stage_summary
#   - qc_recode_measure_summary
#   - qc_recode_column_summary
#   - qc_final_missingness_summary
#   - qc_sociometric_roster_summary
#   - qc_sociometric_edge_summary
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
})

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preconditions
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(exists("registry_items"))
stopifnot(exists("registry_measures"))
stopifnot(exists("subject_roster"))
stopifnot(exists("expected_n_subjects"))

stopifnot(exists("part1_measures_list_raw"))
stopifnot(exists("sensitive_measures_list_raw"))
stopifnot(exists("part2_measures_list_raw"))

stopifnot(exists("part1_measures_list_recoded"))
stopifnot(exists("sensitive_measures_list_recoded"))
stopifnot(exists("part2_measures_list_recoded"))

stopifnot(exists("part1_measures_list_final"))
stopifnot(exists("sensitive_measures_list_final"))
stopifnot(exists("part2_measures_list_final"))

stopifnot(exists("part2_final"))
stopifnot(exists("sociometric_edgelists"))
stopifnot(exists("sociometric_nomination_rosters"))
stopifnot(exists("sociometric_edgelist_all"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

fail_on_nonempty <- function(df, label, n = 20) {
  if (nrow(df) > 0) {
    message("QC FAILURE: ", label)
    print(df, n = min(n, nrow(df)))
    stop(label, call. = FALSE)
  }
}

get_guts_col <- function(df) {
  guts_candidates <- c("gutsID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "GUTSID", "GutsID")
  guts_col <- guts_candidates[guts_candidates %in% names(df)][1]
  if (is.na(guts_col)) stop("Could not find a gutsID column in dataset.")
  guts_col
}

is_open_question <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  !is.na(x0) & x0 == "open question"
}

parse_special_code_values <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  if (is.na(x0) || x0 == "") return(numeric(0))

  vals <- str_split(x0, ";", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  vals <- str_squish(vals)
  vals <- vals[vals != ""]
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]

  sort(unique(vals))
}

find_matching_columns <- function(df, var) {
  prefix <- if (str_ends(var, "_")) var else paste0(var, "_")
  base   <- str_remove(var, "_$")

  exact_candidates <- unique(c(var, base))
  exact_match  <- exact_candidates[exact_candidates %in% names(df)]
  prefix_match <- names(df)[str_starts(names(df), fixed(prefix))]

  unique(c(exact_match, prefix_match))
}

same_vector_na <- function(x, y) {
  if (length(x) != length(y)) return(FALSE)

  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  y_chr <- as.character(y)

  same <- (is.na(x) & is.na(y)) | (!is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & x_chr == y_chr)
  all(same)
}

changed_columns <- function(df1, df2, exclude = "gutsID") {
  cols <- intersect(names(df1), names(df2))
  cols <- setdiff(cols, exclude)

  cols[!purrr::map_lgl(cols, ~ same_vector_na(df1[[.x]], df2[[.x]]))]
}

audit_measure_list <- function(measures_list, component_name, stage_name) {
  if (length(measures_list) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      component         = character(),
      stage             = character(),
      short_name        = character(),
      n_rows            = integer(),
      n_cols            = integer(),
      has_gutsID        = logical(),
      n_missing_guts    = integer(),
      n_duplicate_guts  = integer()
    ))
  }

  purrr::imap_dfr(measures_list, function(df, short_name) {
    has_guts <- "gutsID" %in% names(df)

    if (!has_guts) {
      tibble(
        component         = component_name,
        stage             = stage_name,
        short_name        = short_name,
        n_rows            = nrow(df),
        n_cols            = ncol(df),
        has_gutsID        = FALSE,
        n_missing_guts    = NA_integer_,
        n_duplicate_guts  = NA_integer_
      )
    } else {
      dup_n <- df %>%
        filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
        count(gutsID, name = "n") %>%
        filter(n > 1) %>%
        nrow()

      tibble(
        component         = component_name,
        stage             = stage_name,
        short_name        = short_name,
        n_rows            = nrow(df),
        n_cols            = ncol(df),
        has_gutsID        = TRUE,
        n_missing_guts    = sum(is.na(df$gutsID) | df$gutsID == ""),
        n_duplicate_guts  = dup_n
      )
    }
  })
}

compare_list_names <- function(list_a, list_b, component_name, stage_a, stage_b) {
  tibble(
    component = component_name,
    stage_a   = stage_a,
    stage_b   = stage_b,
    only_in_a = list(setdiff(names(list_a), names(list_b))),
    only_in_b = list(setdiff(names(list_b), names(list_a)))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_only_in_a = lengths(only_in_a),
      n_only_in_b = lengths(only_in_b)
    ) %>%
    filter(n_only_in_a > 0 | n_only_in_b > 0)
}

empty_recode_measure_summary <- function() {
  tibble(
    component             = character(),
    short_name            = character(),
    n_changed_cols        = integer(),
    n_allowed_recode_cols = integer(),
    n_unexpected_changed  = integer(),
    n_flagged_columns     = integer(),
    n_raw_special_hits    = integer(),
    n_remaining_specials  = integer(),
    n_post_range_viol     = integer()
  )
}

empty_recode_column_summary <- function() {
  tibble(
    component              = character(),
    short_name             = character(),
    variable_name          = character(),
    column_name            = character(),
    recode_values          = character(),
    raw_special_hits       = integer(),
    remaining_special_hits = integer(),
    post_range_violations  = integer(),
    changed                = logical()
  )
}

empty_unexpected_changes <- function() {
  tibble(
    component   = character(),
    short_name  = character(),
    column_name = character()
  )
}

empty_remaining_specials <- function() {
  tibble(
    component      = character(),
    short_name     = character(),
    variable_name  = character(),
    column_name    = character(),
    remaining_hits = integer()
  )
}

empty_post_range_issues <- function() {
  tibble(
    component       = character(),
    short_name      = character(),
    variable_name   = character(),
    column_name     = character(),
    substantive_min = numeric(),
    substantive_max = numeric(),
    n_violations    = integer()
  )
}

empty_missing_flag_targets <- function() {
  tibble(
    component     = character(),
    short_name    = character(),
    variable_name = character()
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize shared core objects
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

subject_roster <- subject_roster %>%
  transmute(gutsID = as.character(gutsID)) %>%
  mutate(gutsID = str_squish(gutsID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
  distinct(gutsID) %>%
  arrange(gutsID)

subject_ids <- subject_roster$gutsID

registry_items_qc <- registry_items %>%
  mutate(
    component             = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
    short_name            = str_squish(as.character(short_name)),
    variable_name         = str_squish(as.character(variable_name)),
    variable_values       = if ("variable_values" %in% names(.)) as.character(variable_values) else NA_character_,
    needs_scale_recode    = if ("needs_scale_recode" %in% names(.)) coalesce(as.logical(needs_scale_recode), FALSE) else FALSE,
    special_code_values   = if ("special_code_values" %in% names(.)) as.character(special_code_values) else NA_character_,
    substantive_scale_min = if ("substantive_scale_min" %in% names(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(substantive_scale_min)) else NA_real_,
    substantive_scale_max = if ("substantive_scale_max" %in% names(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(substantive_scale_max)) else NA_real_
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) LINKAGE-BASED ROSTER INTEGRITY
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_roster_dups <- subject_roster %>%
  count(gutsID, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n > 1)

qc_roster_size <- tibble(
  n_subject_roster = nrow(subject_roster),
  expected_n       = expected_n_subjects
) %>%
  filter(n_subject_roster != expected_n)

fail_on_nonempty(qc_roster_dups, "subject_roster contains duplicate gutsID values")
fail_on_nonempty(qc_roster_size, "subject_roster row count does not match expected_n_subjects")

qc_subject_roster_soc_mismatch <- if (exists("subject_roster_soc")) {
  subject_roster_soc_qc <- subject_roster_soc %>%
    transmute(gutsID = as.character(gutsID)) %>%
    mutate(gutsID = str_squish(gutsID)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
    distinct(gutsID) %>%
    arrange(gutsID)

  tibble(
    n_subject_roster     = nrow(subject_roster),
    n_subject_roster_soc = nrow(subject_roster_soc_qc),
    set_equal            = setequal(subject_roster$gutsID, subject_roster_soc_qc$gutsID),
    order_equal          = identical(subject_roster$gutsID, subject_roster_soc_qc$gutsID)
  ) %>%
    filter(!set_equal | !order_equal | n_subject_roster != n_subject_roster_soc)
} else {
  tibble(
    n_subject_roster = integer(),
    n_subject_roster_soc = integer(),
    set_equal = logical(),
    order_equal = logical()
  )
}

fail_on_nonempty(qc_subject_roster_soc_mismatch, "subject_roster and subject_roster_soc do not match")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) REGISTRY INTEGRITY
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

registry_missing_core <- registry_items_qc %>%
  filter(
    is.na(component) | component == "" |
      is.na(short_name) | short_name == "" |
      is.na(variable_name) | variable_name == ""
  ) %>%
  select(component, short_name, variable_name)

registry_bad_recode_meta <- registry_items_qc %>%
  filter(needs_scale_recode) %>%
  filter(is.na(special_code_values) | str_squish(special_code_values) == "") %>%
  select(component, short_name, variable_name, special_code_values)

registry_bad_recode_range <- registry_items_qc %>%
  filter(needs_scale_recode) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(substantive_scale_min) |
      is.na(substantive_scale_max) |
      substantive_scale_max < substantive_scale_min
  ) %>%
  select(component, short_name, variable_name, substantive_scale_min, substantive_scale_max)

fail_on_nonempty(registry_missing_core,      "registry_items has missing core identifiers")
fail_on_nonempty(registry_bad_recode_meta,   "registry_items has needs_scale_recode items without special_code_values")
fail_on_nonempty(registry_bad_recode_range,  "registry_items has needs_scale_recode items with invalid substantive scale bounds")

qc_registry_recode_watch <- registry_items_qc %>%
  filter(needs_scale_recode) %>%
  select(
    component,
    short_name,
    variable_name,
    special_code_values,
    substantive_scale_min,
    substantive_scale_max
  ) %>%
  arrange(component, short_name, variable_name)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) MEASURE-NAME CONSISTENCY ACROSS STAGES
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_name_mismatch <- bind_rows(
  compare_list_names(part1_measures_list_raw, part1_measures_list_recoded, "part1", "raw", "recoded"),
  compare_list_names(sensitive_measures_list_raw, sensitive_measures_list_recoded, "sensitive", "raw", "recoded"),
  compare_list_names(part2_measures_list_raw, part2_measures_list_recoded, "part2", "raw", "recoded"),

  compare_list_names(part1_measures_list_recoded, part1_measures_list_final, "part1", "recoded", "final"),
  compare_list_names(sensitive_measures_list_recoded, sensitive_measures_list_final, "sensitive", "recoded", "final"),
  compare_list_names(part2_measures_list_recoded, part2_measures_list_final, "part2", "recoded", "final")
)

fail_on_nonempty(qc_name_mismatch, "measure list names differ across processing stages")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) BASIC STAGE AUDITS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_measure_stage_summary <- bind_rows(
  audit_measure_list(part1_measures_list_raw,     "part1",     "raw"),
  audit_measure_list(sensitive_measures_list_raw, "sensitive", "raw"),
  audit_measure_list(part2_measures_list_raw,     "part2",     "raw"),

  audit_measure_list(part1_measures_list_recoded,     "part1",     "recoded"),
  audit_measure_list(sensitive_measures_list_recoded, "sensitive", "recoded"),
  audit_measure_list(part2_measures_list_recoded,     "part2",     "recoded"),

  audit_measure_list(part1_measures_list_final,     "part1",     "final"),
  audit_measure_list(sensitive_measures_list_final, "sensitive", "final"),
  audit_measure_list(part2_measures_list_final,     "part2",     "final")
)

qc_stage_missing_guts <- qc_measure_stage_summary %>%
  filter(!has_gutsID | n_missing_guts > 0 | n_duplicate_guts > 0)

fail_on_nonempty(qc_stage_missing_guts, "one or more measure datasets are missing gutsID, contain missing gutsID, or contain duplicate gutsID rows")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) RAW -> RECODED CONSISTENCY + RECODE BEHAVIOR
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

compare_raw_recoded_component <- function(raw_list, recoded_list, component_name, registry_items_df) {

  measure_names <- names(raw_list)

  measure_summary <- empty_recode_measure_summary()
  column_summary  <- empty_recode_column_summary()
  unexpected_changes <- empty_unexpected_changes()
  remaining_specials <- empty_remaining_specials()
  post_range_issues  <- empty_post_range_issues()
  missing_flag_targets <- empty_missing_flag_targets()

  for (meas in measure_names) {
    df_raw <- raw_list[[meas]]
    df_rec <- recoded_list[[meas]]

    if (nrow(df_raw) != nrow(df_rec)) {
      stop("QC FAILURE: raw vs recoded row counts differ for ", component_name, "/", meas, call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (!identical(names(df_raw), names(df_rec))) {
      stop("QC FAILURE: raw vs recoded column names differ for ", component_name, "/", meas, call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (!same_vector_na(df_raw$gutsID, df_rec$gutsID)) {
      stop("QC FAILURE: gutsID values differ between raw and recoded for ", component_name, "/", meas, call. = FALSE)
    }

    changed_cols <- changed_columns(df_raw, df_rec, exclude = "gutsID")

    reg_flagged <- registry_items_df %>%
      filter(component == component_name, short_name == meas, needs_scale_recode)

    allowed_cols <- character(0)

    if (nrow(reg_flagged) > 0) {
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(reg_flagged))) {
        v      <- reg_flagged$variable_name[i]
        codes  <- parse_special_code_values(reg_flagged$special_code_values[i])
        smin   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(reg_flagged$substantive_scale_min[i]))
        smax   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(reg_flagged$substantive_scale_max[i]))

        target_cols <- setdiff(find_matching_columns(df_raw, v), "gutsID")

        if (length(target_cols) == 0) {
          missing_flag_targets <- bind_rows(
            missing_flag_targets,
            tibble(
              component     = component_name,
              short_name    = meas,
              variable_name = v
            )
          )
          next
        }

        allowed_cols <- unique(c(allowed_cols, target_cols))

        for (col in target_cols) {
          raw_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_raw[[col]]))
          rec_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_rec[[col]]))

          raw_hits <- if (length(codes) == 0) 0L else sum(!is.na(raw_num) & raw_num %in% codes)
          remaining_hits <- if (length(codes) == 0) 0L else sum(!is.na(rec_num) & rec_num %in% codes)

          range_violations <- if (!is.na(smin) && !is.na(smax)) {
            sum(!is.na(rec_num) & (rec_num < smin | rec_num > smax))
          } else {
            0L
          }

          column_summary <- bind_rows(
            column_summary,
            tibble(
              component              = component_name,
              short_name             = meas,
              variable_name          = v,
              column_name            = col,
              recode_values          = if (length(codes) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(codes, collapse = ";"),
              raw_special_hits       = raw_hits,
              remaining_special_hits = remaining_hits,
              post_range_violations  = range_violations,
              changed                = col %in% changed_cols
            )
          )

          if (remaining_hits > 0) {
            remaining_specials <- bind_rows(
              remaining_specials,
              tibble(
                component      = component_name,
                short_name     = meas,
                variable_name  = v,
                column_name    = col,
                remaining_hits = remaining_hits
              )
            )
          }

          if (range_violations > 0) {
            post_range_issues <- bind_rows(
              post_range_issues,
              tibble(
                component       = component_name,
                short_name      = meas,
                variable_name   = v,
                column_name     = col,
                substantive_min = smin,
                substantive_max = smax,
                n_violations    = range_violations
              )
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }

    unexpected_cols <- setdiff(changed_cols, allowed_cols)

    if (length(unexpected_cols) > 0) {
      unexpected_changes <- bind_rows(
        unexpected_changes,
        tibble(
          component   = component_name,
          short_name  = meas,
          column_name = unexpected_cols
        )
      )
    }

    measure_summary <- bind_rows(
      measure_summary,
      tibble(
        component             = component_name,
        short_name            = meas,
        n_changed_cols        = length(changed_cols),
        n_allowed_recode_cols = length(unique(allowed_cols)),
        n_unexpected_changed  = length(unexpected_cols),
        n_flagged_columns     = if (nrow(reg_flagged) == 0) 0L else n_distinct(column_summary$column_name[column_summary$component == component_name & column_summary$short_name == meas]),
        n_raw_special_hits    = if (nrow(column_summary) == 0) 0L else sum(column_summary$raw_special_hits[column_summary$component == component_name & column_summary$short_name == meas], na.rm = TRUE),
        n_remaining_specials  = if (nrow(column_summary) == 0) 0L else sum(column_summary$remaining_special_hits[column_summary$component == component_name & column_summary$short_name == meas], na.rm = TRUE),
        n_post_range_viol     = if (nrow(column_summary) == 0) 0L else sum(column_summary$post_range_violations[column_summary$component == component_name & column_summary$short_name == meas], na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  }

  list(
    measure_summary      = measure_summary,
    column_summary       = column_summary,
    unexpected_changes   = unexpected_changes,
    remaining_specials   = remaining_specials,
    post_range_issues    = post_range_issues,
    missing_flag_targets = missing_flag_targets
  )
}

qc_recode_part1     <- compare_raw_recoded_component(part1_measures_list_raw,     part1_measures_list_recoded,     "part1",     registry_items_qc)
qc_recode_sensitive <- compare_raw_recoded_component(sensitive_measures_list_raw, sensitive_measures_list_recoded, "sensitive", registry_items_qc)
qc_recode_part2     <- compare_raw_recoded_component(part2_measures_list_raw,     part2_measures_list_recoded,     "part2",     registry_items_qc)

qc_recode_remaining_specials <- bind_rows(

fail_on_nonempty(qc_recode_missing_flag_targets,  "registry flagged recode items that could not be matched to split columns")

fail_on_nonempty(qc_recode_post_range_issues,     "recoded flagged items contain values outside substantive range")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) FINAL PADDED ROSTER INTEGRITY
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

audit_final_roster <- function(measures_list, component_name, subject_ids, expected_n) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(measures_list, function(df, short_name) {
    tibble(
      component        = component_name,
      short_name       = short_name,
      n_rows           = nrow(df),
      expected_n_rows  = expected_n,
      row_count_ok     = nrow(df) == expected_n,
      roster_set_ok    = setequal(as.character(df$gutsID), subject_ids),
      roster_order_ok  = identical(as.character(df$gutsID), subject_ids),
      n_duplicate_guts = df %>%
        filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
        count(gutsID, name = "n") %>%
        filter(n > 1) %>%
        nrow()
    )
  })
}

qc_final_roster_summary <- bind_rows(
  audit_final_roster(part1_measures_list_final,     "part1",     subject_ids, expected_n_subjects),
  audit_final_roster(sensitive_measures_list_final, "sensitive", subject_ids, expected_n_subjects),
  audit_final_roster(part2_measures_list_final,     "part2",     subject_ids, expected_n_subjects)
)

qc_final_roster_fail <- qc_final_roster_summary %>%
  filter(!row_count_ok | !roster_set_ok | !roster_order_ok | n_duplicate_guts > 0)

fail_on_nonempty(qc_final_roster_fail, "final padded measure datasets do not match the subject roster exactly")

qc_final_missingness_summary <- bind_rows(
  purrr::imap_dfr(part1_measures_list_final, function(df, nm) {
    item_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "gutsID")
    n_all_missing <- if (length(item_cols) == 0) nrow(df) else sum(rowSums(!is.na(df[, item_cols, drop = FALSE])) == 0)
    tibble(
      component            = "part1",
      short_name           = nm,
      n_rows               = nrow(df),
      n_all_item_missing   = n_all_missing,
      pct_all_item_missing = if (nrow(df) == 0) NA_real_ else round(100 * n_all_missing / nrow(df), 2)
    )
  }),
  purrr::imap_dfr(sensitive_measures_list_final, function(df, nm) {
    item_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "gutsID")
    n_all_missing <- if (length(item_cols) == 0) nrow(df) else sum(rowSums(!is.na(df[, item_cols, drop = FALSE])) == 0)
    tibble(
      component            = "sensitive",
      short_name           = nm,
      n_rows               = nrow(df),
      n_all_item_missing   = n_all_missing,
      pct_all_item_missing = if (nrow(df) == 0) NA_real_ else round(100 * n_all_missing / nrow(df), 2)
    )
  }),
  purrr::imap_dfr(part2_measures_list_final, function(df, nm) {
    item_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "gutsID")
    n_all_missing <- if (length(item_cols) == 0) nrow(df) else sum(rowSums(!is.na(df[, item_cols, drop = FALSE])) == 0)
    tibble(
      component            = "part2",
      short_name           = nm,
      n_rows               = nrow(df),
      n_all_item_missing   = n_all_missing,
      pct_all_item_missing = if (nrow(df) == 0) NA_real_ else round(100 * n_all_missing / nrow(df), 2)
    )
  })
) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_all_item_missing), component, short_name)

part2_guts_col <- get_guts_col(part2_final)

) %>%

fail_on_nonempty(soc_roster_names_mismatch, "sociometric edgelists and nomination rosters do not cover the same questions")

qc_sociometric_roster_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(sociometric_nomination_rosters, function(df, question) {
  dup_n <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gutsID), gutsID != "") %>%
    count(gutsID, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1) %>%
    nrow()

  tibble(
    question                    = question,
    n_rows                      = nrow(df),
    expected_n_rows             = expected_n_subjects,
    row_count_ok                = nrow(df) == expected_n_subjects,
    roster_set_ok               = setequal(as.character(df$gutsID), subject_ids),
    roster_order_ok             = identical(as.character(df$gutsID), subject_ids),
    n_duplicate_guts            = dup_n,
    n_no_participation          = sum(df$nominations == "no_participation", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_invalid_no_participation  = sum(df$gutsID %in% part2_respondent_ids & df$nominations == "no_participation", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_missing_no_participation  = sum(!(df$gutsID %in% part2_respondent_ids) & (is.na(df$nominations) | df$nominations != "no_participation"), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_blank_remaining           = sum(df$gutsID %in% part2_respondent_ids & (is.na(df$nominations) | df$nominations == ""), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(question)

qc_sociometric_roster_fail <- qc_sociometric_roster_summary %>%
  filter(
    !row_count_ok |
      !roster_set_ok |
      !roster_order_ok |
      n_duplicate_guts > 0 |
      n_invalid_no_participation > 0 |
      n_missing_no_participation > 0
  )

fail_on_nonempty(qc_sociometric_roster_fail, "sociometric nomination rosters failed structural or participation-status checks")

qc_sociometric_edge_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(sociometric_edgelists, function(df, question) {
  tibble(
    question          = question,
    n_edges           = nrow(df),
    n_from            = dplyr::n_distinct(df$from),
    n_to              = dplyr::n_distinct(df$to),
    n_invalid_from    = sum(!(as.character(df$from) %in% subject_ids)),
    n_invalid_to      = sum(!(as.character(df$to) %in% subject_ids)),
    n_duplicate_edges = nrow(df) - nrow(distinct(df))
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(question)

qc_sociometric_edge_fail <- qc_sociometric_edge_summary %>%
  filter(n_invalid_from > 0 | n_invalid_to > 0 | n_duplicate_edges > 0)

fail_on_nonempty(qc_sociometric_edge_fail, "sociometric edgelists contain invalid IDs or duplicate rows")

fail_on_nonempty(qc_sociometric_combined_fail, "sociometric_edgelist_all does not match the sum of per-question edgelists")

qc_sociometric_unmapped_summary <- if (exists("sociometric_unmapped")) {

} else {

}
```

At this stage all Wave 1 datasets have been prepared for export. The previous steps created two types of outputs: sociometric edgelists representing participant nominations, and measure level datasets containing the cleaned questionnaire items for each scale.

This chunk writes those objects to disk using a standardized directory structure. Sociometric edgelists are written to dedicated network folders, while the remaining behavioral measures are exported as separate files corresponding to each measure defined in the overview manifest.

The export step ensures that all processed datasets are saved in a consistent format and location so they can be easily accessed for analysis or reused by other team members without needing to rerun the full cleaning pipeline.




```{r}
###############################################################################
# STEP X) EXPORT OUTPUTS (WAVE 1)
#
# Exports into ONE root folder:
#   <out_base_dir>/measures/
#
# A) Sociometrics
#   - Edgelists:
#       <out_meas_dir>/sociometrics/<question>/
#       <out_meas_dir>/sociometrics/_combined/
#   - Subject-level nomination rosters:
#       <out_meas_dir>/sociometrics/<question>/
#
# B) Measures
#   - Exports one file per final short_name:
#       <out_meas_dir>/<short_name>/
#
# Core naming rule:
#   variable_name        = source column name in cleaned Qualtrics data
#   export_variable_name = final shared/export column name
#
# Important:
#   This block uses variable_name to locate columns and only renames to
#   export_variable_name immediately before writing the final files.
#
#   Source blocks can split into multiple final measures.
#   Example:
#     part1/edu -> demographics + studyres
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(haven)
  library(tibble)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
})

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

site_id <- "lei"
ses_id  <- "01"

if (!exists("dir0") || !nzchar(dir0)) {
  stop("dir0 is unavailable. Run the configuration/import section first.")
}

out_base_dir <- file.path(dir0, "Behavioral", "T1", "data_processed")
out_meas_dir <- file.path(out_base_dir, "measures")
out_soc_dir  <- file.path(out_meas_dir, "sociometrics")
receipts_dir <- file.path(out_meas_dir, "_receipts")

crosswalk_path <- file.path(
  dir0,
  "Behavioral/T1/T1_behavioral_overview_with_official_item_crosswalk.xlsx"
)

timestamp_now <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Set TRUE while debugging so old folders do not confuse checks.
purge_existing_exports <- FALSE

if (!file.exists(crosswalk_path)) {
  stop(
    "The export crosswalk file was not found:\n",
    crosswalk_path,
    "\n\nPlace the file there or update crosswalk_path before running export."
  )
}

if (purge_existing_exports && dir.exists(out_meas_dir)) {
  message("Purging previous measure exports from: ", out_meas_dir)
  unlink(out_meas_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
}

dir.create(out_meas_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_soc_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(receipts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

message("EXPORT ROOT (measures): ", out_meas_dir)
message("  Sociometrics dir: ", out_soc_dir)
message("  Receipts dir:     ", receipts_dir)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

assert_safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  bad <- str_detect(x, "[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\s]")

  if (any(bad, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Unsafe name(s) for folder/file naming: ",
      paste(unique(x[bad]), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

is_open_question <- function(x) {
  x0 <- str_squish(tolower(as.character(x)))
  !is.na(x0) & x0 == "open question"
}

guess_id_cols <- function(df) {
  priority <- c(
    "gutsID",
    "guts_id",
    "gutsid",
    "subject_id",
    "participant_id",
    "ppn",
    "PPN",
    "ResponseId",
    "response_id"
  )

  intersect(priority, names(df))
}

choose_join_col <- function(dfs, short_name) {
  id_cols_each <- purrr::map(dfs, guess_id_cols)
  common_id_cols <- Reduce(intersect, id_cols_each)

  priority <- c(
    "gutsID",
    "guts_id",
    "gutsid",
    "subject_id",
    "participant_id",
    "ppn",
    "PPN",
    "ResponseId",
    "response_id"
  )

  join_col <- priority[priority %in% common_id_cols][1]

  if (length(join_col) == 0 || is.na(join_col)) {
    stop(
      "Cannot combine measure `", short_name, "` because no common ID column was found.\n\n",
      "Columns by source:\n",
      paste(
        purrr::map_chr(seq_along(dfs), function(i) {
          paste0("source_", i, ": ", paste(names(dfs[[i]]), collapse = ", "))
        }),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  }

  join_col
}

check_unique_ids <- function(df, join_col, context) {
  missing_ids <- df %>%
    mutate(.join_id_chr = as.character(.data[[join_col]])) %>%
    filter(is.na(.join_id_chr) | .join_id_chr == "")

  if (nrow(missing_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing ID values found before export join.\n",
      "Context: ", context, "\n",
      "Join column: ", join_col, "\n",
      "Number of rows with missing IDs: ", nrow(missing_ids)
    )
  }

  dup_ids <- df %>%
    mutate(.join_id_chr = as.character(.data[[join_col]])) %>%
    count(.join_id_chr, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(dup_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate ID values found before export join.\n",
      "Context: ", context, "\n",
      "Join column: ", join_col, "\n",
      "Example duplicate IDs: ",
      paste(head(dup_ids$.join_id_chr, 20), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

values_match_or_fillable <- function(existing, incoming) {
  existing_chr <- as.character(existing)
  incoming_chr <- as.character(incoming)

  ok <- is.na(existing_chr) |
    is.na(incoming_chr) |
    existing_chr == incoming_chr

  all(ok, na.rm = TRUE)
}

coalesce_mixed <- function(existing, incoming) {
  existing_chr <- as.character(existing)
  incoming_chr <- as.character(incoming)

  dplyr::if_else(
    !is.na(existing_chr),
    existing_chr,
    incoming_chr
  )
}

make_sav_safe <- function(df) {
  df_sav <- df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.numeric))

  names(df_sav) <- make.names(names(df_sav), unique = TRUE)

  df_sav
}

normalize_edgelist <- function(df, question = NULL) {
  df2 <- df
  nms <- names(df2)

  from_candidates <- nms[str_detect(nms, "(^|\\.)from$|(^|_)from$|^from_id$")]
  to_candidates   <- nms[str_detect(nms, "(^|\\.)to$|(^|_)to$|^to_id$")]

  if (!("from" %in% nms) && length(from_candidates) >= 1) {
    df2 <- df2 %>% rename(from = all_of(from_candidates[1]))
  }

  if (!("to" %in% names(df2)) && length(to_candidates) >= 1) {
    df2 <- df2 %>% rename(to = all_of(to_candidates[1]))
  }

  if (!all(c("from", "to") %in% names(df2))) {
    stop(
      "Edgelist does not contain `from` and `to` after normalization.\n",
      "Columns present: ", paste(names(df2), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(question) && !("question" %in% names(df2))) {
    df2$question <- question
  }

  if (!("item" %in% names(df2))) {
    df2$item <- NA_character_
  }

  df2 %>%
    select(any_of(c("from", "to", "question", "item")))
}

standardize_registry_like <- function(x) {
  out <- as_tibble(x) %>%
    janitor::clean_names() %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_squish(.x)))

  needed_chr <- c(
    "component",
    "short_name",
    "variable_name",
    "variable_values",
    "export_variable_name",
    "official_variable_name",
    "official_variable_label",
    "official_values",
    "metadata_task",
    "metadata_source_file",
    "metadata_source_sheet",
    "official_mapping_status",
    "mapping_note",
    "export_name_duplicate_flag"
  )

  for (nm in needed_chr) {
    if (!nm %in% names(out)) {
      out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(
      component = tolower(str_squish(as.character(component))),
      short_name = str_squish(as.character(short_name)),
      variable_name = str_squish(as.character(variable_name)),
      variable_values = as.character(variable_values),
      export_variable_name = str_squish(as.character(export_variable_name)),
      official_variable_name = str_squish(as.character(official_variable_name)),
      official_variable_label = as.character(official_variable_label),
      official_values = as.character(official_values),
      metadata_task = str_squish(as.character(metadata_task)),
      metadata_source_file = as.character(metadata_source_file),
      metadata_source_sheet = as.character(metadata_source_sheet),
      official_mapping_status = str_squish(as.character(official_mapping_status)),
      mapping_note = as.character(mapping_note),
      export_name_duplicate_flag = as.character(export_name_duplicate_flag)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      export_variable_name = if_else(
        !is.na(export_variable_name) & export_variable_name != "",
        export_variable_name,
        variable_name
      ),
      official_variable_name = na_if(official_variable_name, ""),
      official_mapping_status = na_if(official_mapping_status, ""),
      metadata_task = na_if(metadata_task, "")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(component), component != "",
      !is.na(short_name), short_name != "",
      !is.na(variable_name), variable_name != ""
    )
}

read_external_crosswalk <- function(path) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(path)

  sheet_to_read <- if ("T1_behavioral_crosswalk" %in% sheets) {
    "T1_behavioral_crosswalk"
  } else if ("T1_behavioral" %in% sheets) {
    "T1_behavioral"
  } else {
    sheets[1]
  }

  message("Reading export crosswalk: ", path)
  message("  sheet: ", sheet_to_read)

  readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet_to_read, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
    standardize_registry_like()
}

build_export_xwalk <- function(registry_items, crosswalk_path) {
  base <- standardize_registry_like(registry_items) %>%
    mutate(
      source_component = component,
      source_short_name = short_name
    )

  external <- read_external_crosswalk(crosswalk_path)

  external_key_conflicts <- external %>%
    count(component, variable_name, name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(external_key_conflicts) > 0) {
    message("NOTE: duplicate component x variable_name rows found in external crosswalk. Keeping first occurrence.")
    print(external_key_conflicts, n = 100)
  }

  external_dedup <- external %>%
    arrange(component, variable_name, short_name, export_variable_name) %>%
    distinct(component, variable_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(
      component,
      variable_name,
      crosswalk_short_name = short_name,
      crosswalk_export_variable_name = export_variable_name,
      crosswalk_official_variable_name = official_variable_name,
      crosswalk_official_variable_label = official_variable_label,
      crosswalk_official_values = official_values,
      crosswalk_metadata_task = metadata_task,
      crosswalk_metadata_source_file = metadata_source_file,
      crosswalk_metadata_source_sheet = metadata_source_sheet,
      crosswalk_official_mapping_status = official_mapping_status,
      crosswalk_mapping_note = mapping_note,
      crosswalk_export_name_duplicate_flag = export_name_duplicate_flag
    )

  base %>%
    left_join(
      external_dedup,
      by = c("component", "variable_name")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      short_name = coalesce(crosswalk_short_name, short_name),
      export_variable_name = coalesce(
        crosswalk_export_variable_name,
        export_variable_name,
        variable_name
      ),
      official_variable_name = coalesce(
        crosswalk_official_variable_name,
        official_variable_name
      ),
      official_variable_label = coalesce(
        crosswalk_official_variable_label,
        official_variable_label
      ),
      official_values = coalesce(
        crosswalk_official_values,
        official_values
      ),
      metadata_task = coalesce(
        crosswalk_metadata_task,
        metadata_task
      ),
      metadata_source_file = coalesce(
        crosswalk_metadata_source_file,
        metadata_source_file
      ),
      metadata_source_sheet = coalesce(
        crosswalk_metadata_source_sheet,
        metadata_source_sheet
      ),
      official_mapping_status = coalesce(
        crosswalk_official_mapping_status,
        official_mapping_status
      ),
      mapping_note = coalesce(
        crosswalk_mapping_note,
        mapping_note
      ),
      export_name_duplicate_flag = coalesce(
        crosswalk_export_name_duplicate_flag,
        export_name_duplicate_flag
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with("crosswalk_"))
}

split_source_measure_block <- function(df, component_name, source_short_name, registry_export_xwalk) {

  df <- as_tibble(df)

  id_cols <- guess_id_cols(df)
  data_cols <- setdiff(names(df), id_cols)

  hits <- registry_export_xwalk %>%
    filter(component == component_name) %>%
    filter(variable_name %in% data_cols) %>%
    distinct(variable_name, short_name)

  if (nrow(hits) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        component = component_name,
        source_short_name = source_short_name,
        short_name = source_short_name,
        df = list(df)
      )
    )
  }

  variable_conflicts <- hits %>%
    count(variable_name, name = "n_short_names") %>%
    filter(n_short_names > 1)

  if (nrow(variable_conflicts) > 0) {
    stop(
      "One or more source variables map to multiple final short_names.\n",
      "Component: ", component_name, "\n",
      "Source short_name: ", source_short_name, "\n",
      "Problem variable(s): ",
      paste(variable_conflicts$variable_name, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  matched_cols <- hits$variable_name
  unmatched_cols <- setdiff(data_cols, matched_cols)

  split_index <- hits %>%
    group_by(short_name) %>%
    summarise(
      keep_cols = list(variable_name),
      n_matched_items = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # If a source block maps to one final short_name, keep unmatched columns with it.
  # This protects local/fallback columns.
  if (length(unmatched_cols) > 0 && nrow(split_index) == 1) {
    split_index$keep_cols[[1]] <- c(split_index$keep_cols[[1]], unmatched_cols)
  }

  # If a source block maps to multiple final short_names and has unmatched columns,
  # do not guess where they belong.
  if (length(unmatched_cols) > 0 && nrow(split_index) > 1) {
    stop(
      "A source measure block maps to multiple final short_names and also has unmatched columns.\n",
      "Component: ", component_name, "\n",
      "Source short_name: ", source_short_name, "\n",
      "Matched final short_names: ",
      paste(split_index$short_name, collapse = ", "), "\n",
      "Unmatched columns: ",
      paste(unmatched_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n\n",
      "These columns need to be assigned before export."
    )
  }

  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    list(split_index$short_name, split_index$keep_cols),
    function(final_short_name, keep_cols) {

      df_sub <- df %>%
        select(any_of(c(id_cols, keep_cols)))

      tibble(
        component = component_name,
        source_short_name = source_short_name,
        short_name = final_short_name,
        df = list(df_sub)
      )
    }
  )
}

combine_same_measure_dfs <- function(df_info, short_name) {
  if (nrow(df_info) == 1) {
    return(df_info$df[[1]])
  }

  dfs <- df_info$df
  source_labels <- paste(df_info$component, df_info$source_short_name, sep = "/")

  join_col <- choose_join_col(dfs, short_name)

  purrr::walk2(
    dfs,
    source_labels,
    ~ check_unique_ids(
      .x,
      join_col,
      paste0("short_name=", short_name, "; source=", .y)
    )
  )

  message(
    "Combining `", short_name, "` across sources: ",
    paste(source_labels, collapse = ", "),
    " using ID column: ", join_col
  )

  out <- dfs[[1]]

  for (i in 2:length(dfs)) {
    next_df <- dfs[[i]]
    next_source <- source_labels[[i]]

    overlapping_cols <- intersect(
      setdiff(names(out), join_col),
      setdiff(names(next_df), join_col)
    )

    if (length(overlapping_cols) > 0) {
      for (col in overlapping_cols) {
        check_df <- full_join(
          out %>% select(all_of(join_col), existing = all_of(col)),
          next_df %>% select(all_of(join_col), incoming = all_of(col)),
          by = join_col
        )

        if (values_match_or_fillable(check_df$existing, check_df$incoming)) {
          merged_col <- check_df %>%
            mutate(merged = coalesce_mixed(existing, incoming)) %>%
            select(all_of(join_col), merged)

          out <- out %>%
            select(-all_of(col)) %>%
            left_join(merged_col, by = join_col) %>%
            rename(!!col := merged)

          next_df <- next_df %>%
            select(-all_of(col))

          message("  Coalesced overlapping column for `", short_name, "`: ", col)
        } else {
          stop(
            "Conflicting overlapping column found while combining `", short_name, "`: ", col, "\n",
            "This column exists in more than one source and has different non-missing values.\n",
            "Problem source: ", next_source, "\n",
            "Inspect this before export."
          )
        }
      }
    }

    out <- full_join(out, next_df, by = join_col)
  }

  out
}

prepare_one_measure_for_export <- function(df, short_name, registry_export_xwalk) {
  id_cols <- guess_id_cols(df)
  data_cols <- setdiff(names(df), id_cols)

  xwalk_all <- registry_export_xwalk %>%
    filter(short_name == .env$short_name)

  if (nrow(xwalk_all) == 0) {
    rename_receipt <- tibble(
      short_name = short_name,
      source_variable_name = data_cols,
      export_variable_name = data_cols,
      official_variable_name = NA_character_,
      rename_status = "no_registry_rows_for_short_name_kept_source_name",
      official_mapping_status = NA_character_,
      mapping_note = "No registry rows found for this short_name.",
      metadata_task = NA_character_,
      metadata_source_file = NA_character_,
      metadata_source_sheet = NA_character_,
      timestamp = timestamp_now
    )

    return(list(
      data = df,
      variable_renaming_receipt = rename_receipt,
      unmatched_official_receipt = rename_receipt %>%
        transmute(
          short_name,
          source_variable_name,
          export_variable_name,
          reason = rename_status,
          official_mapping_status,
          mapping_note,
          timestamp
        )
    ))
  }

  source_conflicts <- xwalk_all %>%
    group_by(variable_name) %>%
    summarise(
      n_export_names = n_distinct(export_variable_name),
      export_names = paste(sort(unique(export_variable_name)), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_export_names > 1)

  if (nrow(source_conflicts) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Registry conflict for short_name `", short_name, "`.\n",
      "The same source variable_name maps to multiple export_variable_name values:\n",
      paste(
        paste0(source_conflicts$variable_name, " -> ", source_conflicts$export_names),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  }

  xwalk_unique <- xwalk_all %>%
    arrange(variable_name, export_variable_name) %>%
    distinct(variable_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  xwalk_present <- xwalk_unique %>%
    filter(variable_name %in% names(df))

  actual_not_in_registry <- setdiff(data_cols, xwalk_unique$variable_name)

  rename_lookup <- setNames(
    xwalk_present$export_variable_name,
    xwalk_present$variable_name
  )

  future_names <- names(df)
  matched <- future_names %in% names(rename_lookup)
  future_names[matched] <- unname(rename_lookup[future_names[matched]])

  duplicated_future_names <- unique(future_names[duplicated(future_names)])

  if (length(duplicated_future_names) > 0) {
    dup_detail <- tibble(
      source_variable_name = names(df),
      proposed_export_name = future_names
    ) %>%
      filter(proposed_export_name %in% duplicated_future_names)

    stop(
      "Duplicate final column names would be created for short_name `", short_name, "`.\n",
      "Problem export names: ",
      paste(duplicated_future_names, collapse = ", "),
      "\nSource variables involved:\n",
      paste(
        paste0(dup_detail$source_variable_name, " -> ", dup_detail$proposed_export_name),
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  }

  df_out <- df
  names(df_out) <- future_names

  rename_receipt_matched <- xwalk_present %>%
    transmute(
      short_name = short_name,
      source_variable_name = variable_name,
      export_variable_name = export_variable_name,
      official_variable_name = official_variable_name,
      rename_status = if_else(
        variable_name == export_variable_name,
        "kept_same",
        "renamed_to_export_variable_name"
      ),
      official_mapping_status = official_mapping_status,
      mapping_note = mapping_note,
      metadata_task = metadata_task,
      metadata_source_file = metadata_source_file,
      metadata_source_sheet = metadata_source_sheet,
      timestamp = timestamp_now
    )

  rename_receipt_unmatched_actual <- tibble(
    short_name = short_name,
    source_variable_name = actual_not_in_registry,
    export_variable_name = actual_not_in_registry,
    official_variable_name = NA_character_,
    rename_status = "actual_column_not_in_registry_kept_source_name",
    official_mapping_status = NA_character_,
    mapping_note = "Column was present in the measure data frame but was not found in registry_items or the export crosswalk for this short_name.",
    metadata_task = NA_character_,
    metadata_source_file = NA_character_,
    metadata_source_sheet = NA_character_,
    timestamp = timestamp_now
  )

  rename_receipt <- bind_rows(
    rename_receipt_matched,
    rename_receipt_unmatched_actual
  )

  unmatched_official_receipt <- rename_receipt %>%
    filter(
      is.na(official_variable_name) |
        official_variable_name == "" |
        str_detect(
          tolower(coalesce(official_mapping_status, "")),
          "unmatched|unmapped|fallback|missing"
        ) |
        rename_status == "actual_column_not_in_registry_kept_source_name"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      short_name,
      source_variable_name,
      export_variable_name,
      reason = rename_status,
      official_mapping_status,
      mapping_note,
      timestamp
    )

  list(
    data = df_out,
    variable_renaming_receipt = rename_receipt,
    unmatched_official_receipt = unmatched_official_receipt
  )
}

export_one_edgelist <- function(df, question, out_dir) {
  question <- str_remove(as.character(question), "_$")
  assert_safe_name(question)

  q_dir <- file.path(out_dir, question)
  dir.create(q_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  stem <- paste0("guts-", site_id, "_ses-", ses_id, "_item-", question, "_edgelist")

  path_tsv <- file.path(q_dir, paste0(stem, ".tsv"))
  path_rds <- file.path(q_dir, paste0(stem, ".rds"))
  path_sav <- file.path(q_dir, paste0(stem, ".sav"))

  df2 <- normalize_edgelist(df, question = question)

  readr::write_tsv(df2, path_tsv, na = "")
  saveRDS(df2, path_rds)

  df_sav <- df2 %>%
    rename(
      from_id = from,
      to_id   = to
    ) %>%
    make_sav_safe()

  haven::write_sav(df_sav, path_sav)

  tibble(
    export_type = "sociometric_edgelist",
    question    = question,
    n_rows      = nrow(df2),
    n_cols      = ncol(df2),
    path_tsv    = path_tsv,
    path_rds    = path_rds,
    path_sav    = path_sav,
    timestamp   = timestamp_now
  )
}

export_one_nomination_roster <- function(df, question, out_dir) {
  question <- str_remove(as.character(question), "_$")
  assert_safe_name(question)

  q_dir <- file.path(out_dir, question)
  dir.create(q_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  stem <- paste0("guts-", site_id, "_ses-", ses_id, "_item-", question, "_nominations_by_subject")

  path_tsv <- file.path(q_dir, paste0(stem, ".tsv"))
  path_rds <- file.path(q_dir, paste0(stem, ".rds"))
  path_sav <- file.path(q_dir, paste0(stem, ".sav"))

  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      gutsID = as.character(gutsID),
      nominations = as.character(nominations)
    ) %>%
    select(gutsID, nominations)

  readr::write_tsv(df2, path_tsv, na = "")
  saveRDS(df2, path_rds)

  df_sav <- df2 %>%
    rename(
      subject_id = gutsID,
      nominations_text = nominations
    ) %>%
    make_sav_safe()

  haven::write_sav(df_sav, path_sav)

  tibble(
    export_type = "sociometric_nomination_roster",
    question    = question,
    n_rows      = nrow(df2),
    n_cols      = ncol(df2),
    path_tsv    = path_tsv,
    path_rds    = path_rds,
    path_sav    = path_sav,
    timestamp   = timestamp_now
  )
}

)

registry_xwalk_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_registry_export_crosswalk.csv")
readr::write_csv(registry_export_xwalk, registry_xwalk_path)
message("Registry export crosswalk receipt: ", registry_xwalk_path)

export_sets <- list(
  part1     = part1_measures_list_final,
  sensitive = sensitive_measures_list_final,
  part2     = part2_measures_list_final
)

# Build row-level measure index before dropping or combining anything.
# Source blocks may split into multiple final short_names.
# Example: part1/edu can become demographics + studyres.
measure_index_raw <- purrr::imap_dfr(export_sets, function(measures_list, component_name) {

  if (length(measures_list) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      component = character(),
      source_short_name = character(),
      short_name = character(),
      df = list()
    ))
  }

  purrr::imap_dfr(measures_list, function(df, source_short_name) {

    split_source_measure_block(
      df = as_tibble(df),
      component_name = component_name,
      source_short_name = source_short_name,
      registry_export_xwalk = registry_export_xwalk
    )
  })
})

measure_index_raw <- measure_index_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(short_name), short_name != "")

# Drop administrative/sensitive blocks from shared export.
admin_shortnames_to_drop <- c("bsn", "contact")

admin_drop_receipt <- measure_index_raw %>%
  filter(
    source_short_name %in% admin_shortnames_to_drop |
      short_name %in% admin_shortnames_to_drop
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    reason = "administrative_sensitive_not_exported",
    component,
    source_short_name,
    short_name,
    timestamp = timestamp_now
  )

measure_index <- measure_index_raw %>%
  filter(
    !(source_short_name %in% admin_shortnames_to_drop),
    !(short_name %in% admin_shortnames_to_drop)
  )

admin_drop_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_dropped_admin_measures.csv")
readr::write_csv(admin_drop_receipt, admin_drop_path)
message("Administrative drop receipt: ", admin_drop_path)

# Remove sociometric questionnaire blocks from measure export.
# They are handled by the edgelist and nomination roster exports above.
soc_nomination_shortnames <- registry_export_xwalk %>%
  filter(str_starts(variable_name, "sociometric_q")) %>%
  filter(!is_open_question(variable_values)) %>%
  distinct(short_name) %>%
  filter(!is.na(short_name), short_name != "") %>%
  pull(short_name) %>%
  unique()

skipped_measures <- measure_index %>%
  filter(short_name %in% soc_nomination_shortnames) %>%
  transmute(
    reason = "handled_as_sociometric_outputs",
    component,
    source_short_name,
    short_name,
    timestamp = timestamp_now
  )

measure_index <- measure_index %>%
  filter(!(short_name %in% soc_nomination_shortnames))

skipped_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_skipped_measures.csv")
readr::write_csv(skipped_measures, skipped_path)
message("Skipped sociometric measures receipt: ", skipped_path)

assert_safe_name(unique(measure_index$short_name))

duplicate_shortnames <- measure_index %>%
  count(short_name, name = "n_sources") %>%
  filter(n_sources > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_shortnames) > 0) {
  message("Measures found in more than one source block and combined before export:")
  print(duplicate_shortnames, n = 100)
}

source_components_receipt <- measure_index %>%
  group_by(short_name) %>%
  summarise(
    source_components = paste(unique(component), collapse = ","),
    source_blocks = paste(unique(paste(component, source_short_name, sep = "/")), collapse = ","),
    n_sources = n(),
    timestamp = timestamp_now,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

source_components_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_measure_source_components.csv")
readr::write_csv(source_components_receipt, source_components_path)
message("Measure source-components receipt: ", source_components_path)

# Combine same final short_name across all source blocks.
export_measures_combined <- measure_index %>%
  group_by(short_name) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ unique(.x$short_name))) %>%
  map(~ combine_same_measure_dfs(.x, unique(.x$short_name)))

message("Number of measure files after combining by short_name: ", length(export_measures_combined))

# Rename columns for final export only.
prepared_measures <- purrr::imap(
  export_measures_combined,
  ~ prepare_one_measure_for_export(.x, .y, registry_export_xwalk)
)

export_measures_final <- purrr::map(prepared_measures, "data")

variable_renaming_receipt <- purrr::map_dfr(
  prepared_measures,
  "variable_renaming_receipt"
)

unmatched_official_receipt <- purrr::map_dfr(
  prepared_measures,
  "unmatched_official_receipt"
)

variable_renaming_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_variable_renaming.csv")
unmatched_official_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_unmatched_official_names.csv")

readr::write_csv(variable_renaming_receipt, variable_renaming_path)
readr::write_csv(unmatched_official_receipt, unmatched_official_path)

message("Variable renaming receipt: ", variable_renaming_path)
message("Unmatched official names receipt: ", unmatched_official_path)

# Export one file per final short_name.
export_one_measure <- function(df, short_name) {
  assert_safe_name(short_name)

  measure_dir <- file.path(out_meas_dir, short_name)
  dir.create(measure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  stem <- paste0("guts-", site_id, "_ses-", ses_id, "_task-", short_name)

  path_tsv <- file.path(measure_dir, paste0(stem, ".tsv"))
  path_rds <- file.path(measure_dir, paste0(stem, ".rds"))
  path_sav <- file.path(measure_dir, paste0(stem, ".sav"))

  readr::write_tsv(df, path_tsv, na = "")
  saveRDS(df, path_rds)

  df_sav <- make_sav_safe(df)
  haven::write_sav(df_sav, path_sav)

  tibble(
    export_type = "measures",
    component   = "combined",
    short_name  = short_name,
    n_rows      = nrow(df),
    n_cols      = ncol(df),
    path_tsv    = path_tsv,
    path_rds    = path_rds,
    path_sav    = path_sav,
    timestamp   = timestamp_now
  )
}

meas_receipt <- purrr::imap_dfr(export_measures_final, export_one_measure)

meas_receipt_path <- file.path(receipts_dir, "export_receipt_measures.csv")
readr::write_csv(meas_receipt, meas_receipt_path)

message("Measures export complete. Receipt: ", meas_receipt_path)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final summary
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Final measure export count:")
print(meas_receipt %>% count(component, name = "n_measures_exported"))

message("Column rename summary:")
print(
  variable_renaming_receipt %>%
    count(rename_status, name = "n_columns")
)

message("Columns without official item names:")
print(
  unmatched_official_receipt %>%
    count(short_name, name = "n_unmatched_columns") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_unmatched_columns)),
  n = 100
)

message("Demographics source blocks included:")
print(
  source_components_receipt %>%
    filter(short_name == "demographics")
)

message("Study results source blocks included:")
print(
  source_components_receipt %>%
    filter(short_name == "studyres")
)

message("Total sociometric questions exported: ", n_soc_questions)
message("All exports complete. Root: ", out_meas_dir)
```





```{r, eval=FALSE}
###############################################################################
# DEBUG: COMPARE IN-MEMORY AUDIT TO EXPORTED AUDIT FILE
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})

count_rows_with_data <- function(df) {
  id_cols <- intersect(
    c("gutsID", "guts_id", "gutsid", "subject_id", "participant_id", "ppn", "PPN", "ResponseId", "response_id"),
    names(df)
  )
  
  item_cols <- setdiff(names(df), id_cols)
  
  if (length(item_cols) == 0) {
    return(0L)
  }
  
  sum(rowSums(!is.na(df[item_cols]) & as.data.frame(lapply(df[item_cols], as.character)) != "") > 0)
}

audit_in_memory <- part1_measures_list_final$audit

message("\nIN-MEMORY AUDIT:")
print(
  tibble(
    object = "part1_measures_list_final$audit",
    n_rows = nrow(audit_in_memory),
    n_cols = ncol(audit_in_memory),
    n_rows_with_data = count_rows_with_data(audit_in_memory),
    columns = paste(names(audit_in_memory), collapse = ", ")
  ),
  n = Inf
)

audit_receipt <- meas_receipt %>%
  filter(short_name == "audit")

message("\nAUDIT EXPORT RECEIPT:")
print(audit_receipt, n = Inf)

if (nrow(audit_receipt) != 1) {
  stop("Could not find exactly one AUDIT row in meas_receipt.")
}

audit_export_path <- audit_receipt$path_tsv[[1]]

message("\nReading exported AUDIT from:")
message(audit_export_path)

audit_exported <- readr::read_tsv(
  audit_export_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  na = c("", "NA")
)

message("\nEXPORTED AUDIT:")
print(
  tibble(
    object = "exported AUDIT TSV",
    n_rows = nrow(audit_exported),
    n_cols = ncol(audit_exported),
    n_rows_with_data = count_rows_with_data(audit_exported),
    columns = paste(names(audit_exported), collapse = ", ")
  ),
  n = Inf
)

message("\nFIRST 20 EXPORTED ROWS WITH ANY AUDIT DATA:")
id_col_export <- intersect(c("gutsID", "subject_id", "guts_id", "gutsid"), names(audit_exported))[1]
item_cols_export <- setdiff(names(audit_exported), id_col_export)

audit_exported_with_flag <- audit_exported %>%
  mutate(
    any_data = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(item_cols_export)))) > 0
  )

print(
  audit_exported_with_flag %>%
    filter(any_data) %>%
    select(any_of(c(id_col_export, item_cols_export))) %>%
    head(20),
  n = 20
)

message("\nROWS WITH DATA BY OBJECT:")
print(
  tibble(
    object = c("in_memory_final", "exported_tsv"),
    n_rows = c(nrow(audit_in_memory), nrow(audit_exported)),
    n_rows_with_data = c(
      count_rows_with_data(audit_in_memory),
      count_rows_with_data(audit_exported)
    )
  ),
  n = Inf
)
```
